title.rendered: What is AI mode in LG AC to improve comfort?

content.rendered:
With so many advancements in the technology, there are so many things that are being introduced in the market like refrigerators, smartphones, washing machines or air conditions. As all the brands are offering so many new features and innovative electronic goods, it is getting really easy for these brands to attract a lot of people. There are so many brands that you see in the market when it comes to latest Air Conditioner, with the best features and the best deals as well.

What is AI Mode in LG AC?

AI mode in LG AC – It means an Artificial Intelligence mode which is added in LG air conditionors. Go on the mode change button and find the artificial intelligence mode on the AC remote screen on display. One of the top brands that are in the market today is LG. You will be able to find the top and best air conditioners from LG. There are so many designs and models available from this brand. You will be able to choose from a wide range of collection and that is the best part of this brand LG. So, are you planning to buy an air conditioner? Then, before you look at the artificial intelligence controlled air conditioner from LG, let us look at a few basic things that you should know before you buy any air conditioner. You should be very careful when you are choosing an air conditioner, whether it is for your home or for your office. If you are buying an air conditioner for the first time, then here are a few things that you need to consider.

Specifications To Look For When Buying An Air Conditioner:

The technology has completely changed and you are able to see some interesting features in every electronic device these days. It is the same with air conditioners as well; they have changed a lot these days. They are in fact able to perform more than a typical air conditioner. They don’t just cool the air but does much more things. But do not get tempted with some features which are shown in an air conditioner, but are not at all useful for you. So, here is a list of some important features that an air conditioner should have when you are buying one.

Check Out The Chassis Type:

You will have to check out the chassis type very well. That plays a very important role when you are installing it and when you will have to get it repaired in case of any problem with the air conditioners. Some air conditioners will have heavy chassis and some will have very light one. Some air conditioners will also have detachable chassis as well. So, it is always good to go for light weight one, so that you will be able to get it installed with ease and the maintenance can also be done with ease. When you are going for window air conditioners, then slide out chassis is the best choice that you can make because you will be able to get the ac repair in Vadodara works done from the outside which can be pretty easy for the mechanic as well.

BTU Output

This parameter or feature is basically the cooling capacity of the air conditioner. When you are selecting the air conditioner, you should always make sure that you know the BTU factors as that plays a very important role in the performance of the air conditioner in the room. When you are selecting too high BTU output unit, then that is not going to do its job in the right way that means it does not dehumidify in the right way. At the same time, when you are selecting an under power one also; you will not have to see that it is performing well. So, it is always important that you select the right one.

Star Rating For Energy Saving

You will be able to find the air conditioners with star ratings and that is for saving some energy. Your air conditioner should be saving at least ten percent more power than the government standards. Only then the air conditioner will be qualified for energy saving star ratings. The more the number of stars, then more energy you will be able to save with that air conditioner. So, you need to be really smart while selecting one. You can go for either three-star rating air conditioner or you can also go for five-star rating air conditioner as well.

Warranty of The Air Conditioner

This is one of the must-have features that you must check without missing it. There is a very simple logic behind it. When the manufacturer is sure about their products, then they will surely stand for them. But if they are not ready to stand for it, then why you should even opt for them. The minimum warranty that you should look for is one year for the complete unit, including the labor charges as well.

Adjustable Louvers

The louvers are very helpful in adjusting the air flow in the direction that you want. You will be able to distribute the air in all the directions as per your choice and that is very important to consider. You may not have too many options with the window air conditioners, but with split air conditioners you will be able to adjust them in different directions for sure.

Adjustable Fan Controls

When you are choosing an air conditioner, you should also have to concentrate on the fan speed. You should be able to adjust the fan speed according to your choice and it should be having at least three different kinds of speed adjustments.

Digital Display

Initially, only the split air conditioners had that kind of features, but now the window air conditioners are also having this kind of feature. It is going to help you in adjusting the required temperature in the right way and that is very important. You will have the remote control and you will be able to operate it from any place as well.

Timer Facility

You should also be able to set the timer of the air conditioner. This will help you in operating the air conditioner when you are not at home and it can get the room cool by the time you reach home. At the same time, when you are sleeping, you will be able to set the timer to switch off the air conditioner after a certain period of time. That can save you some money over the electricity bill.

Air Purifiers And Filters

You should be having the best purifiers and filters for your air conditioners. You don’t have to always look for some easy to remove kind of filters as you are not going to remove them and clean them. You have the required technician for doing that job. All you will have to make sure is you are choosing an air conditioner with cleaner and best filter which are easy to clean, but not something that is easy to replace.

Dehumidifier Facility

You will be able to find some kind of air conditioners which are going to just act as the de-humidifiers. During certain seasons, you need not have to keep your house cool for a very long time and this kind of feature or facility is going to be useful at this point of time. These are some of the very important features that you will surely have to check. That means you cannot just neglect any of the features as you are investing on the air conditioner and you will need that to work for a long time. So, make sure that you do a good research before you actually buy one.

Air Conditioner Sizing

Did you anytime here about this air conditioner sizing concept? If you have ever gone for shopping an air conditioner, then you might have heard this word. This is also one of the important things that you should know when you are buying an air conditioner, be it an LG air conditioner or any other. This factor calculation can help you in making the best use of the air conditioner that you buy. In fact, you are going for a simple window air conditioner or an artificial intelligence fitted air conditioner, from LG, this information can be really useful for you. Use Of Air Conditioners The basic function of an air conditioner is either to remove the heat present in the room or for adding some heat to the temperature of the room. The sizing factor is important for knowing the capacity to heat removal or heat addition in the room where the air conditioner is fitted. Units Used For Determining Sizing The basic units that are used for determining the sizing factor of the air conditioner are BTU which means British Thermal Units, Watts, and ton as well. It can be easy for you to understand the sizing concept while buying an air conditioner when you are familiar with these units.
  • 1 ton is equal to 12000 BTU per hour.
  • 12000 BTU per hour is equal to 3516 Watts (or you can say it is 3.516 kW).

Fundamentals of Air Conditioner Sizing

The basic concept of this sizing is based on how the heat is removed and how it is added. It is a common thing that when the temperature outside is hot, then you need to remove the heat from the room or the building. When the temperature outside is cool, then you need to add heat to the building or room. That means, in simple words, you should be able to balance the temperature outside and inside in order to get the temperature that you desire.

What Factors Are Going To Decide The Amount Of Heat To Be Added Or Removed?

There are some simple things or factors to decide this:

Temperature Difference

The difference in the temperature that needs in your room and the temperature outside the room is one of the basic factors. When you are having hot summer, then you need to remove a lot of heat from the room to make it cool and to maintain it. At the same time, on a mild day, when it is not too hot or too cold, you need not have to do much.

The Material Used In The Room

The material that is used for the construction of the room is going to make the difference. If you are having two rooms of the same size, but the material used is different like one is made of glass, whereas the other is made of brick, then that is definitely going to make a difference. The one made of glass will need more energy to remove heat and to make it cool and maintain it cool for a longer time.

The Wall Surface

When the surface area is more, then it will release more heat and at the same time gain heat as well. So, this is one of the factors determining the sizing.

Infiltration

If there are any cracks in the wall, any gaps in the doors, any holes in the doors, any ventilation facility available in the room, which would allow air to pass in and out of the room, then it can be tough for the air conditioner to maintain the desired temperature and that also affects the sizing.

Kind Of Activity In The Room

If the place where the air conditioner is placed is used for hot baths, cooking or gymnasium, then there will be more heat generated continuously and you will have to keep the temperature really low to maintain the desired temperature. If you are using it for sleeping or reading, the temperature will remain the same all the time.

The Square Meter Method

When you are choosing an air conditioner, then you can see that the sales person will ask you the size of your room. Basically, a blind calculation is 1 ton for five hundred square feet of the floor area. This is a simple and blind calculation, which can be ideal in most of the cases. But this calculation will again depend on all the above factors specified. So, you will have to make sure that you are considering all the factors and then buying the right air conditioner, which can keep the room cool for a longer time and at the same time it does not take too much time for cooling. Something like dual panel air conditioner can be a good choice because it has two panels for cooling nearby and far areas of the room. At the same time, you can save energy by switching off one panel when not required.

Artificial Intelligence Fitted Air Conditioners From LG:

LG AI Based Air Conditioner is one of the new innovations of this brand. You will be able to select from nineteen different models of air conditioners which are fitted with the artificial Intelligence feature. Among so many different models from AI Ready Air Conditioner, Whisen Dual Air conditioner is a popular one.

Whisen Dual Air Conditioner

This air conditioner is having two different cold air outlets and they are controlled individually. With this air conditioner, you will be able to control the direction of the air flow along with the strength of the air. This is definitely one of the best models from LG because it is very easy to satisfy people with just one air conditioner. You will be able to enjoy good cooling speed in just no time and along with that you will also be able to save energy as well. That means you will be able to enjoy the temperature that you need without having to spend too high. Dual Panel – Is An Advantage Generally, the problem that you may face with the normal air conditioners is you will not be able to receive air to all parts of the room. But when you are using this air conditioner, then you will be able to adjust the panels of it according to your choice. You can adjust one panel of the air conditioner towards the people sitting close to the air conditioner and the other panel can be adjusted according to the people sitting in the other corner or at a far distance. Consumers Very Little Energy – Saves Power There are so many interesting features in this air conditioner that many consumers will be worried about the power consumption. That is just a myth only. You will, in fact, be able to save more power using this LG air conditioner. You will be able to save 40 percent energy. When you are using just one panel, then you will be able to save more 35 percent compared to two panels operating. When you compare with the other models of the air conditioners whether, from LG brand or other brands, the cooling time is 20 percent less than them. Apps For Checking The Conditioner Of The LG Air Conditioner You have apps like KaKao Talk, LINE and LG Whisen App using which you will be able to control the air conditioner. You will be able to control and manage it even if you are outside. You will be able to check the overall condition of the air conditioner and then use it accordingly. With the help of these apps, you will also be able to check the replacement periods and bills as well. Smog Deodorization Filter This particular Whisen dual air conditioner is having the best filters like 3MTM Ultra fine particle filter which is going to help in removing dust from the air. It is going to filter even the 0.02 pm size dust particles as well. The smog deodorization filter helps in maintaining the odor of the room as well. Energy Frontier Certification All the 19 models of air conditioners that are having artificial intelligence feature are energy frontier certified. That means you will be able to save 150 percent more energy and hence you will be able to save more money as well. This is one the best air conditioners released by LG. Maintenance Of LG Air Conditioner One of the best innovations done by the human beings is air conditioners and LG is working towards providing the best air conditioners to the esteemed customers. You have the best and beautiful models of air conditioners from LG, which are just perfect for the summers in India, in fact from all parts of the world. You will be able to enjoy a cool and pleasant environment when you have the LG air conditioner installed in your house or your workplace. One important thing to remember about the air conditioners is they are not cheap, and LG is promising its customers to offer the air conditioners at the best possible price. Whatever is the price, you will have to make sure that you are maintaining the air conditioner in the right way. This is going to help in keeping the air conditioner in a good condition for a longer time. Remember, there is no one who is going to buy a new air conditioner every year. You will have to make sure that you are maintaining it in the right way. Keep A Performance Check As long as the air conditioner is giving you cool air, you will not concentrate on the air conditioner maintenance and this is something done by everyone. But even if it is giving cool air, the air conditioner is losing the efficiency by 5 percent every year. Usually, if you are not maintaining well, then they will stop working soon. The normal life span of an air conditioner is for 15 years and sometimes, it can run for a longer time if you are really maintaining well. You will have to check for the unusual sounds coming from the air conditioner, the water leakage or the drain tubes as well. Check The Filters You will have to make sure that the filters are always kept. That is when you will be able to get cool and hygienic air in the room. If the filters are not clean and clear, then the air that is being released is not at all perfect and healthy. You should make sure that the air conditioner filters are being cleaned from time to time. If you are having any interest in doing it yourself, then you can ask the technician next time and learn it. It is a very simple and easy process. Do Not Do It Yourself You can try to handle a few minor things can filter cleaning and other minor things yourself. But when you sense that there is something major, then do not even try to open it or use it at any cost. That may worsen the condition of the problem inside. As long as you are having a warranty and free servicing facility available for your air conditioner, you can make use of that facility. That is going to help you in getting the things done for no cost. Do not mishandle the air conditioner, if you are not sure of anything, then you can refer the user manual or get in touch with the experts using the customer support. As long as you handle it with care, the life of the air conditioner is also going to increase. It all depends on how you are using and handling the air conditioners. LG air conditioners usually have a good life and when you handle them right, then you will be able to enjoy the best services from LG. Also View: 4 Signs that AC can’t make it through Summer

<p class="wp-block-paragraph">One of the most frequent issues faced by Samsung refrigerator users is cooling problems. <h3 class="wp-block-heading">2. <strong>Samsung Refrigerator Making Noise</strong></h3>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">If your refrigerator is making unusual noises, it could indicate a problem with the motor, fan, or defrost system. A Samsung refrigerator technician in Vadodara can inspect and replace any worn-out components to restore quiet operation.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Repair Options</strong>:</p>



<ul class="wp-block-list">

<h3 class="wp-block-heading">3. <strong>Ice Maker Not Working</strong></h3>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">A common issue with Samsung fridges is an ice maker that isn’t working. This could be caused by a clogged water filter, an issue with the water inlet valve, or a malfunctioning ice maker motor.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Repair Options</strong>:</p>



<ul class="wp-block-list">
<li>Replacing the water filter.</li>



<li>Fixing the water inlet valve.</li>



<li>Replacing the ice maker motor.</li>
</ul>



<h3 class="wp-block-heading">4. <strong>Water Leakage in Samsung Fridge</strong></h3>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Water leakage from the fridge can be a frustrating issue, often caused by clogged defrost drains, a broken door seal, or a blocked water line.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Repair Options</strong>:</p>



<ul class="wp-block-list">
<li>Fixing or replacing the door seal.</li>



<li>Unclogging or repairing the defrost drain.</li>



<li>Repairing the water line.</li>
</ul>



<h3 class="wp-block-heading">5. <strong>Samsung Refrigerator Freezer Not Freezing</strong></h3>

Common Refrigerator Problems That Require Professional Repair

A fridge that fails to maintain the right temperature can lead to food spoilage. Causes may include a faulty compressor, blocked vents, or refrigerant leaks.

2. Water Leakage Issues

A leaking refrigerator can damage your flooring and lead to mold growth. This issue may be caused by a clogged drain tube or faulty water inlet valve.

3. Excessive Ice Formation in Freezer

Too much frost buildup in your freezer? It could be due to a defective thermostat, malfunctioning defrost timer, or door seal issues.

4. Refrigerator Making Unusual Noises

Loud buzzing or rattling sounds often indicate a problem with the condenser fan, evaporator fan, or compressor.

If your fridge refuses to start, there might be an electrical issue, such as a damaged power cord or malfunctioning control board.

title.rendered: Air Conditioner Maintenance Servicing

content.rendered: If you are living in a place where there is too much of heat and the summer lasts for a long time, then you must be having an air conditioner at home. It is no more a symbol of luxury; most of the houses are having an air conditioner at home. All the offices are also having these air conditioners, especially if they are a software company. It is very important to have air conditioner when there are so many computers present. When you are having an air conditioner, then you will need the air conditioner maintenance services as well. All the companies or offices will generally go to the AC AMC Offer because with the help these offers, you will be able to save some money and a lot of time as well. Air conditioner maintenance is considered as one of the important things to take care when you are using an air conditioner. If you are buying an air conditioner, then you can talk to the sales executive to know how many years is the air conditioner going to work well or what is the life of the air conditioner. You will usually get a reply that the air conditioner is going to last for 10 to 15 years, provided you maintain it every year, else they will not work efficiently at all. Why Is Air Conditioner Maintenance So Important? Many people do not even think of air conditioner maintenance. All they know is just the air conditioner repairs. They do not think of maintaining the air conditioner until and unless there is some problem with the working of the air conditioner. That is not called as air conditioner maintenance. That is called as the air conditioner repair. Do you have a question in mind on why is air conditioner maintenance so important. Usually, you will hardly use your air conditioner in the months of winter and rainy seasons. That means you will completely shut down these air conditioner. But when you are going to start using them again in the summer, then you should make sure that you are going for maintenance. Yes, in the beginning of the spring you can go for air conditioner maintenance. This will help in cleaning the air conditioner and making it ready to operate really well in the summer. Here Is Some Fundamentals Related To Air Conditioner Maintenance When you are thinking about the air conditioner, then you should not forget about the air conditioner maintenance. The maintenance process that you can handle at home by yourself will be saving some money for you. Maintenance is also important for maintaining the hygiene of the room and the air in the room. Here are a few basic things that you need to do as part of the maintenance. Condenser Unit Cleaning Has To Be Done The basic step involved in this condenser cleaning is you will have to make sure that you have removed the debris and the dust in the indoor unit and the outdoor unit as well. You will be able to do it very easily and it does not require too much affords as well. You can also clean the fins of the air conditioner with the help of some small soft brush. You can also see that there are a few fins, which are bent and you will have to make them straight. When the fins are bent, then that can be a problem for the air to move in and out of the air conditioning unit. Checking The Evaporator Drain This is something that you cannot do. This kind of task has to be done only by the experts or the technicians who are having a complete idea about it. If there is any clog in the drain pipe, then you will see that the water starts leaking from the evaporator coil or other areas of the air conditioner. Cleaning The Air Filters This is one of the simple and easy steps that can be done by the owner of the air conditioner. If you are using the air conditioner too many times, then there are more chances that the filters of the air conditioners will be dirty. You will have to clean them yourself as you will not be able to call the maintenance team for such simple thing. You can just remove the air conditioner filters, and then place them under a water tap which is having a little force. Then rub them with a soft brush and then you will be able to clean them really well. You can now easily place them back to the place from where you removed them. You will see that the air is a little cooler than what it was before the filters were cleaned. Filter Are Really Important When you are talking about the maintenance of an air conditioner, whether it is a window air conditioner or a split air conditioner, you will notice that one important part is always mentioned. The maintenance of this part can be done by the user itself if they are having a little knowledge on how to do it. That part is the filters. Yes, it is the filters which can be cleaned by the user and it can be done with ease as well. There are two different kinds of filters like one is the filter which can be used again after cleaning them and the other kind of you can replace the filters with a new one. Many times, you will usually have the filters which can be cleaned and used again. The only thing to concentrate is you should be able to clean it in the right way. title.rendered: How To Choose The Best Air Conditioner For Your Home?

content.rendered:
Numerous Brands are now bringing up amazingly energy- efficient top rated ACs that have been designed exclusively for the benefit of the global markets. And all of these are based on certain important factors like health conditions of the individuals, local climate, feeding habits as well as the consumer requirements. And they cannot be just called as cooling devices, also, these new age air conditioners are also built in a way that is accompanied by the innovative features like air purification, moisture control, and a recently launched phenomenon that repels mosquitoes in a way that is absolutely non-toxic to human so that at the end of the day you can enjoy a sound sleep. The business head of the Air Conditioners of LG India has very clearly explained the most important elements to be taken care of in order to buy an AC this summer, and today we will be talking about the very same context. This is because of the fact that every family, rather every individual has a specific set of habits in accordance to which any air conditioner is to be bought and that is why one needs to be so careful and doing a prior research before buying Air Conditioner.

Factors you should consider before buying AC

Capacity

The first important thing to be noticed is the capacity of the AC. Firstly, the capacity of the air conditioner needed should be taken into consideration depending on the floor size of the room for which the AC is being bought. According to a rough measure, it has been seen that an area in the range of about 120 ~140 Sq. ft. will need 1 ton AC, an area of 150 ~180 Sq. ft. will need 1.5 ton AC and an area of 180 ~240 Sq. ft. will need 2 tons cooling air –conditioner. This is because if this measure is not taken into consideration, then it might happen that a small room is getting a lot cooler than it is supposed to be, and on the other hand a large room is not getting the sufficient cooling effect at all. So the measures prove the fact that for every kind of room there is a specific capacity of the AC, and so all you have to do is to measure your floor area and have an idea of the perfect one.

Energy efficiency

Many people think that energy efficiency is just a random phrase with no meaning, but the truth is far from it. Today there is a tremendous rise in the mercury level of the surroundings and there is no denying the fact that it is responsible for increasing the electricity bill of the entire house. This is the perfect reason why it is a must to buy an energy efficient model of the AC and it has been stated by no other than the Bureau of Energy Efficiency (BEE). Thus, any air conditioning unit with more number of stars will be consuming lesser electricity than the one with a lower star number. For example, if you have two AC in which the one is with a three-star rating and the other is with a five-star rating, then be sure of the fact that the one with the three stars will definitely consume more electricity than the one with a five-star rating.

Split Or Window AC

This is a factor that puts most of the buyers into a fix for people cannot decide whether to have a split model or a window model. To the people who feel that affordability is a factor, window AC is a nice option and the best part is that they are easy to be installed. On the other hand, if you can go to the Split AC, then it is better to do so because these are stylish to look at and are quieter as well. Also, window ACs are big to look at and are not good for the ones with small spaces whereas, in the case of the split AC, space is no longer a problem.

Product Price

As we said earlier, affordability might be a big problem as well as the deciding factor when it comes to buying AC. You have to remember the fact that for every star rating, the price goes up by a minimum of 2500 rupees and so you have to decide what you want to have. You have two choices, either go for a lower star AC and pay a bit more electricity tariff every month or else you could also pay a bit more now and give a less tariff cost. Also, do evaluate the facilities that you get in each of the companies and know the details about them.

Air Quality

What good is an AC if it does not improve the indoor air quality of the home? Well, this is the aspect that is indeed very important when you are investing on ACs at home; and AC with a good filter a must. Check the air filter quality of each of the ACs and make sure that it is efficient while working. The best part of the good filter is that only ensures clean air but also elevates the level of cooling as well as the energy efficiency of the AC. In most of the cases it is seen that the duration of the AC is lessened due to the choking of the coil, but with a good filter, there is no chance how that could happen.

Installation Requirements

While buying any best air conditioner, make sure that the AC installation and AC repair service center is nimble about their work and are readily available otherwise you will have a tough time getting your AC installed. Also, you have to get a basic idea of how any AC is installed – for example, the window AC is a single big unit that has been designed so that it can be attached and fitted to the windows. On the other hand, a split AC has two units- a compressor unit which is placed outside the house and the one indoor unit that is placed inside the room and that are specifically designed for the better flow of air. It is to be remembered that how smoothly the AC will work and how long will it work will depend on the kind of installation that has been done on the same.

Maintenance & Cleaning

When you are buying an AC, make sure that you gain ample knowledge about the servicing and the repair unit of your air conditioner, so that in times of need, you can have someone to come for help when any part of it gets damaged or it stops working properly. Also, it is the duty of the company to let you know about the authenticated service units so that you can call their working staff without any hassles and get all the work done in a jiffy.

Cooling Speed

AC, as we all know, is bought basically for the cooling purpose of the rooms and so you should check whether the AC has a thermostat that can be adjusted very easily or not. Also, make sure that the temperature setting can have at least two cooling speeds which are normally required and a minimum of two fan speeds as well. If you want to use variable speeds for different phases of the day, this setting might help you to a great extent as well. If the setting is energy efficient, then there can be no better thing than it, because it makes the temperature controlling a lot easier.

After Sales Services

After sales services and other such features like warranty are the things that you should look out to. If you are buying an AC and it seems to have a warranty extension, then go for it. It might seem like you are spending unnecessarily, but at the end of one year, when things go wrong, and then you will understand the importance of the warranty extension. But to enjoy that purpose, you first have to search for a service oriented company which has the ability and good sources to meet the servicing and maintenance needs of your air conditioner.

Check The Other Important Features

In most of the AC units, we have seen that it comes with a dehumidification setting, which reduces the moisture content in the room, which helps with more cooling and more comfort. Also, it is important so that you check the noise levels of the unit which sometimes, may range from 19 – 60 decibels. Be sure of the fact that your unit has a sleep mode so that while you are sleeping it can automatically change the temperature so that you do not have to wake up time and again. Also, you could also check the timer mode in which if you set a time, then the AC will turn off automatically.

Multipurpose

In today’s date, AC is not just used for cooling but is also used as a multi-seasonal product which you can also use during the winter season in order to get warm. This Hot & Cold ACs also saves to about 35% more energy than the heaters. ACs is also the best cooling devices for the rainy season in which we have the humid weather. The special cooling methods are also required for the perfect cooling and comfort during this time. So you have to search of an AC with the features that can control moisture to a great extent and relieve us during the monsoons. There is absolutely no need to be a victim of the summer heat when now you can have cheap, energy efficient ACs which also are widely available. Since October 26, 2015, all ENERGY STAR rated ACs four rooms have been asked to meet a new standard, ENERGY STAR 4.0, – which is the one that consumes 10% less power than the prior models of air conditioners. And, these can also be set to provide cooling only where they’re required to so that the room does not become unreasonably cold or hot, and also room air conditioners are a lot cheaper to possess and to operate than central units.

Energy Efficiency Of Room Air Conditioners

The energy efficiency of any room is measured by the specific energy efficiency ratio (EER). The EER is the ratio of the amount of cooling capacity per hour to the power input (in watts). This means that the EER is directly proportional to the efficiency of the rating of the air conditioner. A single increase of 1.0 on the EER scale depicts a 10% increase in the energy efficiency. When you are buying a new room AC, and then have a look at the information about the EER, which can be seen on the Energy Guide label attached to the unit. Go for the one that has a minimum EER rating of 12 also consisting of the ENERGY STAR label. If a product earns the ENERGY STAR, it means that a product meets the stringent energy efficiency guidelines that have been set by the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency and the U.S. Department of Energy. Some of the guidelines are as follows:
  • ENERGY STAR 4.0 labeled room air conditioners are the ones that consume at least 10% lesser energy than the conventional models. You can find a complete list of the ratings on the official website itself.
  • ENERGY STAR 4.0 labeled room ACs often have timers for enhanced temperature control, thus letting you use the minimum possible amount of energy that you need in order to cool your room.

The Proper Size Estimate Of The Air Conditioner

As we discussed formerly, the required cooling of the room AC depends on the size of the room that needs cooling. So in general, Room air conditioners have the cooling capacities that can go from 5,500 Btu per hour to 14,000 Btu per hour. That is the approximate estimate that can be given. Most of the people have the tendency to go for large ACs since they think that larger AC will give better cooling. But that is far from the truth. Instead, an over-sized AC is basically less effective since it wastes time and energy at the same time. The main work of the air conditioner is to eliminate both heat and humidity from the air. But if the unit is too large, then there is a high chance that it will cool the room quickly, but the moisture will not be controlled at all. This may also leave the room with a damp, clumsy feeling. A properly estimated unit will remove the dampness effectively as it cools. To figure out which size unit is best for your cooling needs, you have to check out the air conditioning calculator.

Other Factors To Consider When Buying

When you are going to buy a unit, then the first concern should be to check the wirings of the room or the house and to see whether there is any damage or not. If so, then it should be repaired without delay. In general, the Room units work on 115-volt or 230-volt circuits. The household receptacle is a holder for an 115-volt branch circuit. Large room units rated may need a special circuit so that the installation can be done properly and the unit can run smoothly. If you are placing your air conditioner near or at the corner of the room, you have to look for a unit that can move the direction of the airflow in the desired way for your room layout so that good infiltration can be done. If you require fitting the air conditioner at the narrow passage of an elongated room, then search for units that have a “turbo” fan mode so that that can drive and distribute the air further into the room. Some other features to look for are being mentioned as follows:
  • A filter that can slide out easily for the regular cleaning purpose,
  • Controls that are arranged in a logical manner,
  • A digital thermostat setting that can be controlled easily,
  • A timer to switch the AC off whenever needed.

Ask Yourself – Do You Need A Smart Air Conditioner?

For those people who have a tendency to stick to the regular schedule but are not in possession of smart home devices installed in their place, a smart timer will surely help save money and also relieve you from coming back to home feeling totally drenched and flushing hotly. But there are many others who have the ability as well as the budget to control their room AC from anywhere. This might seem a bit over the top at the beginning, but can be a huge help and cost savings, especially for the ones who do not have regularity in their lifestyle. These smart units can be synced to the phone and therefore you can control it no matter where you are. Also, they can be connected to the other smart home devices; they can be a part and parcel of your life. This is going to be the best for the ones who are forgetful and you can turn it off no matter where you are.

How To Install Your Air Conditioner?

If you are careful enough to plan a little before installing your air conditioner, then it will save you a lot of money as well as energy. The AC unit should be in perfect level when it is installed so that the internal drainage system, as well as the other mechanism of the unit, can work smoothly. If it’s possible, it is better if you install the unit in the shady spot rather than the sunny spot as because the sunray seems to meddle with the outdoor unit parts a lot. The efficiency of the machine can be lesser by as much as 10% if direct sunlight falls on the same. You can try planting trees and shrubs in order to shade the air conditioner, but please make sure that you are not completely blocking it off. Do not in any way, place lamps or televisions near the air-conditioner’s thermostat system. That is because once thermostat senses heat from these appliances; it will make the AC run longer and in a more intense manner than it is necessary.

Some Do’s and Don’ts to improve life of Air Conditioner

You have to set your air conditioners thermostat as high as it is comfortably possible during the summer months. The bill will be lower is the temperature difference between the indoor and the outdoor unit is less. The thermostat should not be in any way set in the colder setting than normal when you first turn on the air conditioner; since it will not cool your home any faster than it normally does and in turn could result in more cooling and unnecessary cost.

You should always take care to have the fan speed on high during the summer season. Only when the humidity is high, you should set the fan speed on low setting as it will give increased comfort. The lower speed on the humid days will cool your home in a faster way and will eliminate more moisture and dampness from the air because of the slower movement of the air through the cooling equipment.

There are always some things that you should be checking when you are investing on an AC and you should check each and every aspect of the same as well. The above-mentioned facts are to be kept in mind and also you should ask yourself some questions before buying it. Also, make sure that you are investing in some reputed company who has been dealing this aspect for a lot of years and are specializing in the same. So all you have to do is to abide by the mentioned tips and you will see that the product you will get will leave you with no regrets at all. Contact Best AC Service Center in Vadodara for more details.

title.rendered: The Truth About AC Cleaning Charges in Vadodara: What Your Technician Might Not Tell You

content.rendered:
When it comes to keeping your air conditioner (AC) in top shape, AC cleaning is an essential service that shouldn’t be overlooked. If you’re in Vadodara and considering hiring a technician for AC cleaning, it’s crucial to understand the charges, what’s included in the service, and why it’s so important. Unfortunately, many people are unaware of the hidden costs and important details involved in this essential service. In this article, we’ll break down the truth about AC cleaning charges in Vadodara and what you should know before hiring a technician.

What Are the Typical AC Cleaning Charges in Vadodara?

One of the most common questions people have when it comes to AC cleaning is, How much will it cost? The cost of AC cleaning in Vadodara can vary depending on several factors, including the type of AC unit, the complexity of the cleaning process, and the technician’s experience. On average, you can expect charges to range between ₹500 to ₹2,500 for a basic cleaning session. However, this price can increase if you opt for additional services such as deep cleaning, disinfecting, or servicing the filters and coils.

To ensure you’re getting value for your money, always request a detailed breakdown of the charges from the service provider. Some technicians may quote a low price upfront but add hidden fees later, such as charges for cleaning specific parts of the AC or using premium cleaning materials.

What’s Included in AC Cleaning Services?

A typical AC cleaning service includes the following steps:

  1. Cleaning the Filters: Dust and dirt accumulate in the filters over time, reducing the efficiency of your AC. Technicians will remove and clean the filters to ensure proper airflow.
  2. Cleaning the Coils: The evaporator and condenser coils are cleaned to remove dirt, which can impair heat transfer and energy efficiency.
  3. Cleaning the Drain Lines: A clogged drain line can cause water leakage and affect the performance of the unit. Technicians will clean the drain line to prevent this issue.
  4. Disinfecting the System: Many service providers include disinfecting the AC unit to eliminate bacteria, fungi, and mold.
  5. Checking for Faults: Technicians may inspect the AC for any wear and tear, leaks, or other potential problems.

Benefits of Regular AC Cleaning

Regular AC cleaning offers several advantages:

  • Improved Air Quality: A clean AC unit circulates fresh, clean air, reducing allergens and dust in your home.
  • Energy Efficiency: Cleaning the filters and coils helps the AC run more efficiently, which can reduce energy consumption and lower your electricity bills.
  • Extended Lifespan: Regular maintenance ensures your AC unit remains in good working condition for a longer period, delaying the need for costly repairs or replacements.
  • Better Cooling Performance: A clean AC cools your home more effectively, keeping it comfortable during hot Vadodara summers.

Why Choose Our AC Cleaning Service in Vadodara?

At Atlas Aircons, we pride ourselves on offering affordable and high-quality AC cleaning services in Vadodara. We understand the local climate and the specific needs of AC units here, and we provide customized solutions to suit every budget. Our technicians are highly trained and use the latest tools and techniques to ensure your AC is cleaned thoroughly and efficiently.

We offer transparent pricing with no hidden charges, and our service includes a full inspection to identify potential issues that may affect your AC’s performance. Whether you’re looking for a basic cleaning or a full-service overhaul, Atlas Aircons is here to provide you with the best AC cleaning experience in Vadodara.

What Happens If You Skip Regular Cleaning?

  • Reduced cooling efficiency
  • Increased power consumption
  • Growth of mold and bacteria
  • Unpleasant odors
  • Reduced equipment lifespan

How Often Should You Clean Your AC in Vadodara?

Depending on your usage and location:

  • Home ACs: Every 3 to 6 months
  • Office ACs: Every 2 to 4 months
  • ACs near industrial zones: Monthly or bi-monthly

Types of AC Cleaning Services Available in Vadodara

Basic Service vs. Deep Cleaning

Knowing the difference between a basic and a deep clean can help you determine if you’re paying the right amount.

Dry Cleaning (Basic Service)

  • What it includes: Filter dusting, superficial cleaning of the unit.
  • Time required: 20–30 minutes
  • Ideal for: Monthly upkeep, units with light use

Average Price in Vadodara

  • Window AC: Rs. 400–600
  • Split AC: Rs. 500–700

Wet Cleaning (Standard Cleaning)

  • What it includes: Cleaning with water, filter wash, indoor and outdoor coil cleaning.
  • Time required: 45 minutes to 1 hour
  • Ideal for: Bi-annual cleaning

Average Price in Vadodara

  • Window AC: Rs. 600–800
  • Split AC: Rs. 700–1000

Jet Pump or Pressure Cleaning (Advanced)

  • What it includes: High-pressure water jet cleaning, thorough indoor and outdoor unit service.
  • Time required: 1 to 1.5 hours
  • Ideal for: Heavy usage units, pre-summer preparation

Average Price in Vadodara

  • Window AC: Rs. 900–1100
  • Split AC: Rs. 1100–1400

Deep Cleaning with Dismantling

  • What it includes: Complete dismantling of indoor unit, thorough coil and filter cleaning, fan blower and drain pipe flush.
  • Time required: 1.5 to 2.5 hours
  • Ideal for: Annual maintenance

Average Price in Vadodara

  • Window AC: Rs. 1000–1300
  • Split AC: Rs. 1300–1600

Comprehensive Price Table for AC Cleaning in Vadodara (2025)

Note: These are average market rates. Charges may vary slightly based on technician, locality, and service quality.

Hidden Costs Technicians May Not Mention

What to Watch Out For

Even honest-looking service invoices may hide these costs:

Drain Pipe Flushing

  • Usually charged separately: Rs. 200–400

Coil Anti-Fungal Spray

  • Often added during monsoon: Rs. 250–500

Gas Top-Up (Not Full Refill)

  • Small quantity, but costly: Rs. 400–900

Outdoor Unit Accessibility Charges

How to Avoid Overpaying for AC Cleaning in Vadodara

Smart Tips Before Booking a Service

  • Compare Quotes: Always call 2–3 vendors.
  • Ask for Inclusions: Be sure about what’s included in the price.
  • Check Experience: Look for technicians with at least 3+ years of work.
  • Avoid Peak-Time Booking: Charges often rise in April–June.
  • Go for AMC Plans: Saves money if you service your AC more than twice a year.

Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMC) in Vadodara

What They Typically Include

  • 2–4 AC cleanings per year
  • Free service visits
  • Minor parts replacement (filters, bolts, gas top-up)
  • Priority scheduling

AMC Pricing in 2025

  • Window AC: Rs. 1600 – 2500 per year
  • Split AC: Rs. 2000 – 3500 per year

How to Spot a Reliable AC Service Provider

Traits of a Trusted Technician

  • Offers a service guarantee or warranty
  • Provides clear breakdown of pricing
  • Uses proper tools and safety gear
  • Has a visible ID or technician badge
  • Asks before doing any additional paid work

Red Flags to Avoid

  • Extremely low prices (often a bait)
  • Vague answers about services included
  • No invoice or record of service
  • High-pressure upselling tactics

Final Thoughts

In a city like Vadodara, where weather extremes demand reliable cooling solutions, understanding the ins and outs of AC cleaning is not just smart—it’s necessary. This guide empowers you to avoid hidden costs, choose the right service for your needs, and keep your AC running like new.

Whether it’s your first time scheduling a service or your tenth, being informed is your best defense against unnecessary charges and poor workmanship. Stay cool, stay smart—and make sure you know exactly what your AC technician isn’t telling you.

title.rendered: How to Buy Air Conditioner Based on Star Ratings for your needs?

content.rendered:
The air conditioner is a cooling device which is found in almost all houses these days. You will hardly see any house, without an air conditioner. The best part of the air conditioners is you can adjust the room temperature according to your choice, irrespective of the season. That means you will be able to make your room temperature a little higher than what is it is outside in the winter and rainy seasons. While at the same time, in the summer, you will be able to make the temperature less than what it is outside. That means you will be able to get the room temperature of your choice between 16 to 30. Almost all the Latest Air Conditioners are having these temperature settings. Your air conditioner is going to be the best Air conditioner if you are able to buy the best one with all the features that you need in an Air conditioner. Almost all the air conditioners these days are having all the latest features.

Tips For Money Saving When You Are Buying An Air Conditioner

When you are purchasing an air conditioner, you will have to take care of a lot of things. Below are a few tips that can help you in saving some money. When you are following these tips, you will not just save money when you are buying an air conditioner, but you will also be able to save some money when you are using it also. That means you will be able to save some money on your electricity bill. That is the best part of these tips. Please have a look at the tips here:

Select The Right BTU Value For You

There are many people who have bought an air conditioner and are using them as well. But not many of them are even aware or heard the word BTU. BTU stands for British Thermal Units. This is the factor which is going to describe the cooling capacity of the air conditioner and the power of the air conditioner as well. If the BTU value of the air conditioner is high, then the cooling capacity of the air conditioner is also high. You will be able to see that the BTU value of any air conditioner is going to vary from 5000 BTU’s to 30000 BTU’s. If you are not choosing the BTU value in the right way, then you will have to face a lot of problems. Your BTU value is wrong, then it will not be able to do what it is meant to do in the room when you switch it on. So, whatever is the type of the air conditioner, you will have to make sure that you are choosing the right BTU value for your air conditioner and that can help in using the air conditioner in the right way.

Brand Of Your Air Conditioner

The next important factor that you should keep in mind when you are buying an air conditioner is the brand of the air conditioner. Always make sure that the brand of your air conditioner is chosen in the right way. Check the features of an air conditioner when you are buying it. Have certain features in mind that you are looking for in your air conditioner that you are going to buy. You may be able to find the same features in differently branded air conditioners. But do you really think that you can go for any brand when you are able to get the same features? That is going to save you some money as well. That is not the right way to choose an air conditioner. The brand really speaks and when you are buying the right brand at the right price, you will be able to save some money now and after you buy and start using it as well.

Finally, The Model Of The Air Conditioner

Yes, the model of the air conditioner also plays a very important role. You will be able to find different air conditioners in different sizes and also in different options. You will be able to choose the features of the air conditioner as well. The more interesting features that you are looking for, the more will be its price. But you should always make sure that you are buying the model which is having all the features that you are looking for. If you are buying an air conditioner with multiple features, then you will be able to save some money. So, these are the basic tips that can help you in saving some money. That means the first thing to concentrate is the BTU value of the air conditioner, the second is the brand of the air conditioner and the last one is the model of the air conditioner. Check out the different models that you have in the store. You will be able to find some models with different kinds of designs on them. Hence you will be able to find the best air conditioner with all the features that you were looking for. It can sometimes be tough to choose the right brand when there are so many brands available in the market. But if you can do some homework and then start your air conditioner shopping, then you will be able to save some money and time as well. You will be able to find online reviews about the air conditioner and this kind of reviews are given by the real-time users of the air conditioner. So, there can be nothing much better than these reviews for selecting an air conditioner. This way you will be able to find the best model and save some bucks.

Different Air Conditioner Ratings

When you go to buy an air conditioner, you will hear from the sales executive about the air conditioner ratings. What are these ratings? When you are looking for an air conditioner, then there is a lot of information that you need to gather before you buy one. Whether it is a home air conditioner or for your office, you will have to do some research about it. Whenever you are able to buy the right air conditioner, then its efficiency is going to be high and you will be happy for every penny that you have spent on the air conditioner.

Here is a list of a few ratings used in the air conditioners:

EER – Energy Efficient Ratio

The Air Conditioning and Refrigeration Institute or ARI first establishes this ratio.

This rating was first given in the year 1975.

This rating has helped the manufacturer to describe the cooling efficiency.

By looking at just the specification, the seller or the manufacturer will be able to understand the cooling efficiency of the air conditioner.

When you are buying an air conditioner, then you will have to make sure that this EER rating is high.

When the value of the EER is high, then that means that the air conditioner is having good efficiency.

If you are comparing two air conditioners, then you will have to choose the one that is having a higher EER value among those two.

There are a few drawbacks with this EER rating and hence they came up with another kind of rating and that is SEER rating.

SEER – Seasonal Energy Efficiency Ratio

Air Conditioning, Heating and Refrigeration Institute was the first to give this SEER rating.

The non-steady states are not considered in the EER ratings and this rating was made to overcome that factor.

The steady state conditions like the startup and also the shutdown cycles are also considered.

This rating is going to take the outside temperature also into consideration before the rating is given.

Energy Star Rating

Environmental Protection Agency first started using this Energy Star Rating.

This is going to help you know the energy required by different kinds of air conditioners available in the market.

So, you will be able to decide which the right air conditioner for your needs is and hence you will be able to buy the best one.

About The Air Conditioner Labels

You will be able to see the star ratings on the air conditioners when you reach any store for buying the air conditioners.

What are actually these energy star ratings?

This is one of the common questions that are asked by many people.

You will be able to see this on almost all the air conditioner.

The sales executive will try to explain something regarding these ratings to you and you hardly understand that terminology.

So, for those who did not understand that terminology, here is some information in some simple words.

 

What are Star Ratings?

For all those who really have no idea about what is the star rating, here is some information for you. These star ratings are basically developed with the help of the people who are using the air conditioners. You will be able to compare all the models that are present in the showroom. You will know the efficiency of the air conditioner with the help of these star ratings. So, when you are seeing so many models of air conditioners, just see the star rating to compare them.  

Advantages Of Star Ratings

There are so many advantages that you will be able to enjoy with the help of the star ratings that are given by the manufacturers.
  • When you are having a good star rating on the air conditioner, then you will be able to see that the air conditioner is using less energy and hence that is going to save you some money.
 
  • When the star rating is high, then you can consider that the air conditioner is environmental friendly as well. That means they will not damage the environment as much as it is done by other low star rated air conditioners.
 
  • You will be able to see that the air conditioner with high star ratings will give you a good cooling effect for you. You will also be able to save on your power bills as well.

The Stars Speaks

You will be able to find two kinds of stars on the air conditioner. One of them is in blue colour while the other kind of them is in red colour. The blue stars one is going to represent the cooling function of the air conditioner. While the red stars are going to denote the heating function of the air conditioner. Unless and until you are buying a device which is a just cooling device, you will be able to find both the ratings. You will not be able to find the red ratings. When the number of stars on the air conditioner is high, then the air conditioner is more efficient. You will have an air conditioner which is having 10 stars. If the air conditioner is having six stars or more, then you will be able to see an extra rating and that is the super efficiency rating band, just above the normal stars. In the picture that you can see above, you will be able to see that there is an extra arch that is showing its efficiency. You will be able to compare the efficiency of a different air conditioner with the help of the stars that you are seeing on the air conditioner. It is really easy to compare the air conditioner models with the help of these ratings. You need not to have to do too much extra work for comparing two different models of air conditioners that are available in the market nowadays.  

Power Input And The Capacity Output

If you want to know the heating capacity and the cooling capacity of an air conditioner, then you will have to take a look at the capacity values of it. This is one of the best ways to compare the air conditioners when you find two air conditioners with the same star rating. Yes, can be really tough for you to decide which one to buy, when those two look almost the same and when they are the same price. So, with the help of the capacity output value, you will be able to decide which air conditioner to buy. The power Input value is also used for comparing the two air conditioners when the star value is the same. This is going to show how much input power is required by the air conditioner for giving the required cooling or heating effect in the room. So, when you are having the same star rating, then you can go for the capacity output value comparison. But what if these two values are the same? Then you will have to go with the power input value. When the power input value is low, then you can consider that air conditioner. That means the capacity output value should be high while comparison and the power input value should be low while choosing an air conditioner.

The Size Plays An Important Role

When you are choosing an air conditioner for your house or for your office. You should be checking so many things like the models, brand, BTU, star ratings, designs, colours and a few more. But there is one important thing that you generally miss. The size of the room is one important factor on which all these stars and ratings depend on. Yes, you will have to decide the EER and the SEER based on the size of the room. When you go to any store for buying the air conditioner, you will not generally check the size of your room. You will just go to a store and when the sales executive asks you for the size of the room, and then you give some approximate values to them. That is not the way you should be given the size and buy an air conditioner. You should give the size on the feet and then based on that the sales executive will be able to decide the model that can be right for you. Whether it is a master bedroom which is usually big or a normal bedroom, you are going to call it a bedroom. But the capacity output and the power input will definitely vary from them. A bigger room needs more power input to maintain the temperature that they want in the room. So, you should consider the size of the room while buying an air conditioner.

The Material Used For Making The Room Also Matters

A room which is made of bricks is definitely different from the room that is made using the glass. Yes, you will see a lot of difference in both the room when you are installing an air conditioner in that room. So, a room made of glass with need more power for making the room cool and also for maintaining the temperature that you desire. That means, the glass room will keep absorbing the heat inside and hence you will have to manage it. But a room made with the brick does not need so much power to cool the room or you maintain the temperature.

The Insulation Levels Of The Room

If the insulation levels of the room are good enough, then it is easy to maintain the temperature of the room as you desired. You need not to have to take too much stress for it. But if the insulation levels are low, then it is going to consume a lot of energy for maintaining the temperature.

Windows And Their Direction Also Is Important

If there are a number of windows in the room, then there is more chance that the temperature goes high and you will have to run the air conditioner for a longer time. You will not be able to maintain the temperature for a long time and hence you need to run it for a longer time.

Climate Of The Place You Live In

The climatic conditions of the place where you are living are also very important. While the basic temperature outside is always high, it can be really tough to maintain the star ratings that are given. That means the air conditioner that you are choosing should be capable enough to cope up with the temperature that is outside the room. You will have to understand the air conditioner in the right way in order to use it and maintain it in the right way.

Air Conditioners, Best For Your Weather

The technology is developing so well and fasts these days that you will soon be able to buy an air conditioner that is not going to work the same way in every place. You will be able to buy something that is going to work based on the climate conditions in which you are living. BEE has made some new ratings and that is going to take into account the climatic conditions of different places to show the ratings. You will not have to wait too long for getting this kind of air conditioners. The air conditioners should perform really well, even in the high temperature in the city. Our ISEER has given details about the different climatic conditions in different areas of the country. You will now be able to choose your air conditioner based on these ratings. You will be able to see that the air conditioners that you choose based on these ratings will definitely be energy efficient and you will not have to spend too much on the power bills.

Choose The Right Air Conditioners Based On The Suitable Ratings

So, when you are having so many different kinds of ratings to compare two air conditioners and then choose an air conditioner. You will have to choose all the aspects very carefully and make sure that you are choosing the right one. You will have all the ratings given by the manufacturer when you are having a look at the device. All you will have to do just compare the ratings that are available in front of you and then buy the one that you feel is right for you. That means, you will be able to choose the right one and you should always do some homework and then reach the showroom for buying the air conditioner. If you are visiting the store without any homework, then you will end up buying the wrong air conditioner. You are spending a lot of money on an air conditioner and hence you need to be very careful when you are buying one for yourself. Check all the possible parameters and if possible take the help of people who have an idea about the ratings and then you should be buying the air conditioner.

title.rendered: How to Choose the Best AC Repair Service in Vadodara: A Step-by-Step Guide

content.rendered:
Introduction

When the scorching heat of Vadodara hits, your air conditioner becomes more than just a luxury—it’s a necessity. But what happens when your AC starts to malfunction? Finding a reliable and professional AC repair service is crucial to ensure your home remains cool and comfortable. With so many options available, choosing the best AC repair service can feel overwhelming. In this step-by-step guide, we’ll help you navigate the process of selecting the right AC repair service in Vadodara, highlighting key factors that set top-tier service providers apart.

1. Start with Research: Local Reputation Matters

The first step in choosing the best AC repair service in Vadodara is researching local companies. Reputation plays a massive role in ensuring quality service. Look for services with strong customer reviews, testimonials, and word-of-mouth recommendations from friends, family, or neighbors. If a company has been operating in Vadodara for a long time, chances are they’ve earned the trust of the community.

  • Pro Tip: Check Google Reviews, Facebook, and local forums for authentic feedback on the company’s reputation.

2. Check for Relevant Experience

AC repair requires technical expertise, so it’s important to choose a service provider with experience dealing with your specific type and brand of air conditioning unit. The best repair companies in Vadodara will have technicians who are trained and experienced in handling a variety of AC models, from window units to split and central air systems.

  • Pro Tip: Look for companies that specialize in both residential and commercial AC repairs for comprehensive service.

3. Licensing and Certification: Verify Professionalism

The next step is to ensure the AC repair company is properly licensed and certified. In Vadodara, certified technicians are more likely to have the skills necessary to perform quality repairs. Certification from recognized organizations, such as the Indian Society of Heating, Refrigerating and Air Conditioning Engineers (ISHRAE) or equivalent Indian standards, shows the company adheres to industry standards.

  • Pro Tip: Ask for proof of certification or licensing during your initial contact.

4. Get a Quote & Compare Prices

Price should never be the sole factor in choosing an AC repair service, but it is important to understand what you’re paying for. A good AC service provider will offer transparent pricing and give you an estimate before they begin repairs. Be wary of services that offer exceptionally low prices, as they may be cutting corners in terms of quality.

  • Pro Tip: Request a detailed breakdown of services, including parts, labor, and any additional fees.

5. Emergency Repair Services

Air conditioners tend to break down at the most inconvenient times—usually on the hottest days of the year. That’s why you need a repair service in Vadodara that offers quick response times and emergency repair services. Check if they have a 24/7 helpline or offer same-day or next-day service.

  • Pro Tip: Choose a company that provides emergency services, especially during peak summer months.

6. Check for Warranties on Repairs

The best AC repair services stand behind their work. Ensure the company offers warranties or guarantees on their repairs, which gives you peace of mind that you won’t have to pay for the same issue multiple times.

  • Pro Tip: Look for warranties on both parts and labor.

7. Evaluate Customer Service & Communication

Excellent customer service is essential when it comes to AC repair. You want a company that is easy to contact, responds promptly, and communicates clearly. A professional service will be willing to explain the issue, the necessary repairs, and keep you updated on progress.

  • Pro Tip: Test their customer service by calling them with questions before scheduling a service appointment.

8. Ask for Recommendations from Locals

Since AC repair services vary greatly by region, asking locals in Vadodara about their experiences with certain companies can help guide you in the right direction. Neighbors or local community groups often have great insights into which repair services are trustworthy and reliable.

  • Pro Tip: Join local Vadodara Facebook groups or ask for recommendations from your community WhatsApp groups.

9. Look for Eco-Friendly and Energy-Efficient Solutions

If you’re environmentally conscious, opt for an AC repair service that offers eco-friendly solutions, such as environmentally friendly refrigerants or energy-efficient repair options. Not only does this reduce your carbon footprint, but it can also help reduce your energy consumption and lower utility bills in the long run.

  • Pro Tip: Ask if the company uses eco-friendly refrigerants or offers energy-saving maintenance tips.

10. Make Sure They Offer Regular Maintenance Packages

Preventive maintenance is the key to extending the lifespan of your AC and avoiding costly repairs down the road. The best AC repair services in Vadodara will also offer regular maintenance packages, ensuring your AC runs smoothly all year long.

  • Pro Tip: Inquire about regular maintenance contracts to keep your system in peak condition.

Conclusion

Choosing the best AC repair service in Vadodara requires some careful thought and research. By following the steps outlined in this guide, you’ll be equipped to find a reliable, professional service provider who can get your AC up and running efficiently when you need it most. Whether you’re looking for quick repairs, a long-term maintenance plan, or eco-friendly solutions, Atlas Aircon is here to serve you with expertise and dedication. AC Installation Get Your Ac Installed Ease It’s freezing in some parts of our country at the moment and thus, it’s the right time to buy an air conditioner! Yes, the perk of buying something offseason is that we get them at a good bargain in the market. Vadodara, the cultural capital of Gujarat, has witnessed some high temperatures in the recent past and the need of an air conditioner have become a must in summers. Having said that, let’s find out the type of AC we’d need to get ready for this summer.

Types of Air Conditioners

Different types of air conditioners are required for different applications. There are a huge number of factors that shall affect our choice for the best optimization of the product and money spent. This includes the area that’s required to be cooled, net heat generation within the enclosed area and so on. Let’s get to them one at a time.

  • Window Air Conditioning System.
  • Split Air Conditioner System.
  • Packaged Air Conditioner.
  • Central Air Conditioning Plants.

Window Air Conditioner

This is the most frequently used air conditioner for single rooms. In this air conditioner, all the components are enclosed in a single box, It is easy to fit and the unit is fixed into a slot made in a room wall, or rather, a window sill.

Split Air Conditioner

A split air conditioner has an outdoor unit and one indoor unit. The outdoor unit, that contains components like the condenser, expansion valve, compressor, is placed outside the room, houses. The indoor unit comprises of an evaporator and a cooling fan. This unit does not require the making of any slot into the wall of the room. In addition to these, newer technology of split units does not take up as much space as a window unit as they have aesthetic appeal. One or two rooms could be cooled by a split air conditioner simultaneously.

Packaged Air Conditioner

If you want to cool multiple rooms at once or if the target area is quite large, this is your best buy. There are two possible arrangements with the package unit. All the components are contained in a single unit. The condenser could be air cooled or water cooled as per the convenience of the buyer. High capacity blowers are used to throw air into the ducts that are laid through passing by various rooms. In the case of the second arrangement, the compressor and condenser are boxed into a single casing. Located in various rooms, the compressed gas goes through unique units that are particularly assigned. This comprises of the expansion valve and a cooling coil.

Packed air conditioners are of two types based on their type of condensing agent.

    1. Water Cooled: The condenser in this comprises a shell and a tube type. Refrigeration flows alongside the tube and the water flows along the side of the shell for cooling. Water is required for a continuous supply of these systems for the proper functioning of the air conditioning system.
      Parts of the condenser, the shell and tube type, are compact in shape and are boxed into a single unit along with the compressor and expansion valve. The air handling unit used in this includes the cooling coil or the evaporator. The whole packaged air conditioning unit looks like a box from external view and could be controlled by the control panel located on it.
    2. Air Cooled: In this, atmospheric air is used to condense the refrigeration system. It also contains an outdoor unit which is comprised of the most important components like the compressor and the condenser.

In some cases, it also contains the expansion valve. The outdoor unit was kept at a place with free flow of the atmospheric air such a terrace or some other open place.

A fan placed within the casing that sucks the atmospheric air, which is blown over the condenser for cooling the coil. A lot many turns of the copper tubing makes up the condenser coil which is externally finned. It is usually not easy to maintain a continuous flow of the water, hence the packaged ACs that has air cooled condensers are preferred over than the ones with water cooled condensers. Also, since air is available for free. The cooling unit ducts connect to the various rooms that are required to be cooled, which comprises of the evaporator, expansion valve, the air handling blower, and the filter is either located on the floor or hanged on the ceiling.

Central Air Conditioning System

These are to serve the purpose of cooling big buildings, entire hotels, large houses, movie theaters, factories; any place with a huge area to be covered at once. Placing individual units in every room in the case where the entire building is to be cooled becomes very expensive, this makes the central air conditioning system a much better option than all the rest. This type of conditioning system contains a huge compressor that has the capacity to produce hundreds of tons of air conditioning at once. Cooling of huge areas as such malls, galleries etc. are feasible only with central conditioning systems.

Why Buy An Air Conditioner

Now before going further ahead, let’s understand we really need an air conditioner.

Air conditioning was considered a luxury not so long ago, a privileged for a few; now, it has become a mandatory norm in many offices and even so public transportation. So whether we accept it or not, it’s an integral part of our life today.
Let us understand why it has become so popular, and at many places, compulsory.

  • Extreme heat clearly has a negative impact on our physical functioning and intellect. Using of air conditioners rectifies this issue to the very maximum.
  • Great comfort levels while at work and leisure at home.
  • It improves the productivity of people.
  • In most cases, it helps to increase physical activity and helps to maintain a sound state of mind.
  • Low temperatures have proved to reduce the presence of parasites and insects.
  • It reduces the risk of dehydration as lower temperatures lead to produce less sweat in humans.
  • A clean and controlled air conditioning system eradicates external allergens such as that of pollens.
  • It renews and improves air quality if the installation is done well enough and if it is well maintained thereafter.
