title.rendered: How to Clean an Air Conditioner Filter?

content.rendered:
Your air conditioner’s efficiency will decrease if it is not maintained and cleaned regularly. Air filters that are dirty use more energy, leading to higher electricity bills. It can accumulate dirt, bacteria, mildew, and dust if your central air conditioner filter isn’t cleaned regularly. These contaminants can build up in your home and cause a decrease in air quality. This guide will show you how to clean AC filter?

Clean Air Conditioner Filter Process

 

1. Turn off the AC Unit

 

  • When Clean an Air Conditioner Filter, the first thing you should do is turn it off. Unfiltered air can circulate throughout your home if you leave the AC on while cleaning and removing the filter.
  • Your air conditioner should be turned off.
  • To open the unit, use a screwdriver and take out the filter.
  • Some units may have multiple vents. Ensure to inspect the inside of your unit to ensure you have removed all filters.
  • Inspect the filter.

 

2. Vacuum the filter

 

  • It’s time for you to get rid of any dust or buildup.
  • If the central air filter is clean, you can attach the hose to your vacuum cleaner or use a handheld vacuum.
  • If your vacuum hose can’t remove the buildup, it will have to be washed.

 

3. Rinse the Filter

 

  • To deep clean your HVAC filter, mix one-part water with one part white vinegar in a large sink. 
  • It can be rinsed with clean water, dried completely, and returned to the AC unit.
  • You can wash the filter outside if it is too big to fit in your sink. Don’t use a pressurized setting in your hose to avoid damaging the filter.

 

4. Replace the filter

 

  • Air conditioner filters can become worn and damaged over time, so they need to be replaced.
  • You can check for damage by turning off your unit and removing the central AC filter.
  • It’s time for a replacement if your filter shows signs of damage like holes, tears, or excessive grime.
  • You should carefully read the AC filter packaging to determine how long the manufacturer warrants its effectiveness.
  • Keep a reminder on your calendar to change the filter according to manufacturer specifications.

 

Also View: Key Factors for Strange AC Sounds

Air Conditioner Filter Cleaning Tips

 

When cleaning your air conditioner filters, there are some things you should keep in mind. Here, Atlas Aircon – AC Repair in Ahmedabad provides some simple tips to help you Clean Air Conditioner Filter:

  • For optimal efficiency, clean your AC filter every month. If possible, do not clean your AC filter before it reaches 100 degrees in the summer or below freezing in winter.
  • When washing an air filter, let it dry in the sun for 20-30 minutes before replacing it. This will prevent mold problems.
  • The type of filter will determine the cleaning method that you use. A wall air conditioner might have different filter requirements than an HVAC unit. To confirm the best method, refer to the manufacturer’s instructions.
  • Make sure you check to make sure your electrostatic air filter is washable. If it is not, it will need to be replaced when it becomes worn out.
  • It is better to replace disposable air conditioner filters than clean them. Water can cause mold problems and should not be used.
  • It would help if you also cleaned the fan and coils with a canister filled with condensed air. This will remove dust and buildup.

 

You can save energy and reduce your AC’s workload by learning how to clean an air conditioner filter. We have the right tools to clean your AC filter with a vacuum cleaner or water. Atlas Aircon offers an AMC service for AC repair in Vadodara, Gujarat.

title.rendered: Air Conditioner Maintenance Services in Vadodara with Excellent Service Provider

content.rendered:
Air conditioners have become an essential part of everyone’s life and it has become really impossible for people to live without them. If the place where you are living is too hot, then you can hardly imagine your life without an air conditioner. You will be able to spend a peaceful day and also be able to sleep comfortably when you have an air conditioner at work and the workplace.

An air conditioner is no more a symbol of luxury. This has become a requirement these days and most of the people are able to afford them. But air conditioners are not something that you are going to buy every year in the summer.

Most of the air conditioners have a life of 10 years at least, provided if you are able to maintain them properly.

If you are giving good importance to Air Conditioner Maintenance then they may last for a few more years as well.

The Importance Of Air Conditioner Maintenance

Any kind of air conditioners, whether it is a home air conditioner like a window air conditioner and split air conditioner, or whether it is a central air conditioner at your workplace, the AC maintenance plays a very important role.

As told earlier, the minimum life of an air conditioner is 10 years and it can be increased if you are able to maintain them well.

But when you neglect the concept of maintenance, then the life of the air conditioner will come down and you will also have to pay high electricity bills as well.

Why Is Air Conditioner Maintenance Important?

Irrespective of the type of air conditioner that you have in your home or at your workplace, there will be a use of energy source and so many other parts that are inside the air conditioner that you are using.

They all are going to work together in order to make the room cool or hot, depending on the temperature you wanted and the temperature that is present outside the room.

The internal parts play a very vital role in the running of the air conditioner and that is the reason why it is very important that you maintain your air conditioner.

From the moment when the air conditioner performance starts coming down, you will see that the air conditioner is not working in the way that you wanted them to work.

The reason why your air conditioning device stopped working in a normal way all of a sudden is due to the low maintenance.

What Happens When You Neglect Air Conditioner Maintenance?

Usually, there will run a series of steps when you switch on the air conditioner in the home.

As this series of steps involve a lot of things to be done and there will be a lot of parts responsible for it.

When even one single part of the air conditioner is not working in the right way, then you will be able to see some imbalance in its working.

As a result of it, you will not be able to see that the air in the room is well conditioned.

You will not be able to enjoy the room temperature according to the temperature that you wanted.

Voltage fluctuations, grass clippings, dirt in the air conditioner, temperature swings, and other insects are responsible for the wrong functioning of an air conditioner.

Most of the people call up the service centres as they did not concentrate on the maintenance for a long time.

Air Conditioner Maintenance – Means Longer Life For The AC

Many people feel that they will have to spend a lot on air conditioner maintenance, they will have to spare some time.

They feel that it is going to be a big hassle for them and hence they keep avoiding that step.

They do not think of air conditioner servicing, until and unless it stops working completely.

Can you imagine a hot day, after a very busy schedule at work you reach home and your air conditioner is not working?

That is so scary if you are living in a place where the temperature would generally be high even in the evenings.

Regular maintenance of your air conditioner can help you in enjoying your air conditioner for a long time.

You should understand the importance of an air conditioner and its maintenance.

It does not just help you in using it well, but also is going to increase the life of the air conditioner, which is one of the main things that you always look for.

Air conditioners are not something on which you can invest every year or for every two years.

How Often Should You Go For Air Conditioner Maintenance Services?

This is a very common question that many people ask how often should they go for air conditioner maintenance services?

There is another common question that many people ask about the maintenance of the air conditioner and that is why should they go for air conditioner servicing or maintenance when the AC is working well?

These are very common questions asked by many air conditioner users.

Whether your air conditioner is working well or not, it is important that you go for its maintenance at least once in a year.

Going for maintenance in the spring would be the right time.

In these spring months, you can test it well so that it gets ready to keep your room cool and in the temperature that you need when it is too hot outside.

When the HVAC is running, then there will be a lot of dust and dirt getting accumulated in the air conditioner.

When this kind of dust and dirt is getting accumulated, then you will have to clean the filter properly.

When you are not cleaning them timely, then the air conditioner is losing efficiency by at least five percent every year.

That means the machine will not work for ten years like all the air conditioner would work.

Choosing The Right Air Conditioner Maintenance Service Provider Is Important

In order to ensure a long life of your air conditioners, it is very important that you maintain them in the right way.

It is not your job to maintain them.

Rather, you will need experts for this kind of service and hire the right air conditioner maintenance service provider is very important.

When you are able to maintain them in the right way, then you will be able to use your air conditioners at the right time, like in the summer when you need them the most.

When you are not going for maintenance or when you are choosing a wrong or inefficient air conditioner service and maintenance company, then you will end up with replacing your air conditioner very early than required.

So, you will have to give a lot of importance to the air conditioner and also to the service provider that you are choosing.

You will need to spend some time on choosing them.

License Is The First Thing

When you are looking for the air conditioner service and maintenance providers, then the first thing that you will have to look for is the license.

Yes, you will have to look for those who are being licensed.

A professional air conditioner service provider will always be licensed and hence they are the one that you should be choosing.

They are going to handle any kind of damage that has happened to the air conditioner due to some mistake on your end.

You will not have to take responsibility for their mistakes.

Check The Reviews And Feedbacks

You should always make sure that you are checking the complete details of the company which you are planning to hire.

You will be able to find a lot of feedback and reviews on their official website.

This is the first and best place to check the reviews.

But do not stop yourself there; you should even check the other websites where you will be able to find genuine reviews.

This is another way to get the right feedback about the company.

Do not just go with the reviews as they can also be wrong sometimes.

You should do your research about the company once before you can decide on which is the right company for you.

Experience Of The Company

The experience of the company is something that you should concentrate on.

If the company is a startup, then you should think twice before you can hire them.

You can go for hiring them for your home air conditioner maintenance, but do not go for any central air conditioner maintenance or do not think of giving any yearly maintenance contracts to them.

You should always look for a company which is having good years of experience and a team of professionals who are good at their job.

When experienced people are handling the task, then it will be done faster and also the quality of the work would be great.

They will also provide you with some kind of suggestion so that you can take precautionary measure before something actually goes wrong with the air conditioner.

Reputed And Authentic Brands

When you are choosing an air conditioner service company, you should not think about the service charges.

It is important that you are choosing a reputed or authentic brand so that you will not have to lose the efficiency of your air conditioner.

Top and reputed brands work for their reputation and hence will make sure that the services provided them are authentic.

So, even if you will have to pay a little higher, you should always go for the best and top brands in your place.

Get The Right Quote

Let the service provider come home or to the place where the maintenance task to be done.

Let them have a look at the place and then ask for the proper quote.

There will not be any changes in the quote until and unless you are asking for just the maintenance service.

If there is any repair, then the quote depends on the internal condition, the problem and if any parts replacement.

But for general maintenance, it would be same and hence you need to get the quote in advance.

Even if it is a maintenance contract being given, you should make sure to get the quote for it.

The quote should also be in writing in order to avoid any kind of problem in the future.

Smoothing relationship is very important.

Proper Customer Service

The company that you are trying to hire should be having a customer support team, which can help you with all kinds of information that you need.

You should be able to register your complaints and you should also be able to gather all kinds of information that you need about the company and other services that they are offering to their valuable customers.

Check Other Services Offered

Along with providing the maintenance services for the air conditioners, the company should also be able to provide other services like installation of new air conditioners, repairs for the air conditioners and also the sale of spare parts that are required in case of repair.

That means, in simple words, you should look for a service company which can provide you with all kinds of air conditioner services from installation to repairs.

This is going to help you in future as well.

You will be able to get everything done for your air conditioner when you have such a company.

Essential Tips For The Maintenance Of An Air Conditioner

When you want your air conditioner to work at its best and high-efficiency, then you need to make sure that you are taking good care of it.

You should make sure that you are taking care of its maintenance.

Generally, when you talk about maintenance, then you think that it has to be done when the air conditioner stops working or when it is not working in the way it should work.

But now the perspectives of people have changed and they think that it is at least once in a year that you will have to go for maintenance so that the air conditioner is working in a normal way.

These tips are very useful and you should try them before the winter starts. Your HVAC (heating, Ventilation and air conditioning) system will have an air conditioner and furnace.

These two will cool down and heat up when required.

Any type of air conditioner will have an exterior unit which is the compressor and the interior unit which is the blower (evaporator).

All the tips below are applicable to both the units in your home air conditioner.

Shut Down The Power

Any kind of device which works with electricity should be shut down when it is not in use.

That means the power supply to that device has to be put off.

It is the same with your air conditioner as well.

You will have to make sure that you are putting off the air conditioner when you are not using it, maybe in the daytime.

Also in the seasons when you don’t need it, put off the compressor as well, maybe in the winter and rainy seasons.

 Debris Has To Be Cleaned

Debris is usually found in the compressor of the air conditioner.

You will have to unscrew the compressor and then remove the grill from the compressor.

Now, you can clean it manually with the help of a dry cleaner or you can use a wet cleaner as well.

You will even be able to remove it with your hands as well.

Cleaning The Fins

You will have to clean the fins yourself, but make sure that you are not using too much pressure on it.

You can use a garden spray for cleaning the fins and that will help in removing any debris or dirt inside the fins.

You should make sure that there is no too much pressure as that is going to damage the fins in return.

You can also use the fins cleaning spray if it is available.

Fins Straightening Is Important

If there is an air flow reduction in and out of the fins, then there are a lot of chances that the efficiency of the air conditioner will go down.

So, if you find any fins slightly bent, then you will have to make them straight.

You can use a butter knife for this purpose, but you will have to handle it with a lot of care and caution.

You can also buy the fins straightening tool that is available in the market and use it.

Keep The Surrounds Of The Compressor Clean

After you are done with cleaning the debris and dirt inside the compressor and making all the fins straight, it is now time for you to place it back into position.

You need to do it with a lot of care.

Now, you should clean the surroundings of the compressor also clean.

You should cut down all the branches of trees which are very close to the compressor and also clean the ground area around it.

Check The Unit Or Compressor Position

When you leave the outdoor unit or the compressor like that for a longer time, there are chances that it moves from its position.

So, you will have to take care that the unit is placed in the right position.

You should always make sure that the unit is kept in the shade and away from water as well.

Evaporator Coil Has To Be Cleaned

Once you are done with the device at the outdoor, now you will have to move into the device or unit which is inside.

You will have to clean the evaporator coil with the help of spray.

You will have to remove a few screws and then remove the duct and then clean it.

Clean The Air Filter

When you are working on the indoor unit, then the most important thing to take care of is cleaning the filter.

You will be able to do this with a lot of ease. It is going to take a little longer to clean, but the process is very simple.

You will have to get the filter and place them under the tap. Make sure that the water from the tap is having a little pressure.

It is only then they will be cleaned in the right way.

You should also use a small soft brush to clean them when you are placing them in the tap water.

Keep Checking The Wiring Of The Air Conditioner

When you are a thing about the maintenance of the air conditioner, then you will have to concentrate on the wiring part as well.

You will have to make sure that all the wires are always in place.

That is a very important thing to avoid malfunctioning of the air conditioner.

You will have to take a lot of care about the wiring, especially if you are getting anything else done near the air conditioner.

Check The Digital Display Or The Thermostat

You should always keep an eye on the thermostat.

Your room may become cool as soon as you switch on the air conditioner, but you should keep checking if the temperature is really what you adjusted to.

You should make sure that the digital display is showing just what the temperature it is.

You can set the temperature that you want for the room and that should also work in that way only.

Professional Help Can Be The Best Choice

There will be certain things that can be done by you for maintaining the life of the air conditioner and some things have to be done by the professionals only. It is always good that you spend a little money and get all the things done by the professionals as they are experts in handling them. You will be able to get the best services for the professional and it is definitely worth spending every single penny on your air conditioner. You will not have any kind of problem as long as you are hiring the top and best air conditioner service providers.

Central Air Conditioners – Go For Yearly Maintenance Contracts

When you are looking for an air conditioner service provider, then you should go for one time service every year for the home air conditioner. But if it is for the centralized air conditioner at home or workplace, it is better to go for yearly maintenance contracts.You will be able to save a lot when you are given the complete contract to them. They will give you a discount when you are giving them a contract every year. Usually, companies should go for this kind of contracts as they need not have to think of it again. The company, which takes the contract, will take care of all the maintenance tasks every year on time and that is going to relax you. You should get a contract ready for this kind of agreements and the quote should be mentioned clearly in the contract so that there will not be any kind of confusion regarding the payments.

title.rendered: Top 10 Air Conditioners to Buy in Summer 2018

content.rendered:
The economic growth of India and the increasing power parity of purchasing have made it possible for the average earning middle-class families to afford a healthy and comfortable lifestyle. If we talk about air conditioners, they were once considered as a mark of luxury, not a long time ago, but now they have found a good place in almost all the middle-class households. This true for not only in the metro cities but also in the small cities, with the inception of foreign companies and the introduction of newer technologies, benefits of healthcare and energy efficiency, consumers all around have become more aware and they now understand their necessities. The industrial boom and competitive market prices have made possible a wide variety of brands that offer a different product to choose from. Experts in the industry and the analysts have projected that energy efficiency, healthcare, and innovation would be the three commandments that’ll guide the consumers buying behavior. With the ambition to grasp to cover the huge India market, many brands are now launching the high energy efficient air conditioners with five-star ratings that are designed exceptionally. These include many value-added features that developed especially for the Indian market; these are based on the local climatic patterns, health conditions and the consumer requirements. Apart from being able to cool efficiently, these new-age air conditioners are also highly innovative and have features like air purification, humidity control. A newly launched feature, that says to repel mosquitoes in an efficient and non-toxic way around you to ensure a sound sleep, this is especially required in the seasons where serious and hazardous epidemics like malaria, dengue are at their peak. There are various important factors that you should consider before buying an air conditioner this summer. They are:

Required Capacity:

The capacity of your air conditioner ought to be considered with a precision that shall depend on the size of the floor of the room, the AC is required for. Taking a rough measure, an area in the range of: 120 to 140 Sq. ft. would need 1-ton air conditioner cooling capacity 150 to 180 Sq. ft. an area will require 1.5-ton air conditioner cooling capacity and, 180 to 240 Sq. ft. an area will require 2-ton air conditioner cooling capacity.

The Energy Efficiency:

With rising temperature levels today and with the increasing electricity tariffs, an air conditioner model of high energy efficiency is a must-buy. It is made mandatory for all air conditioners have a sticker on them to indicate with star rated energy efficiency; this is also called EER that has been standardized by the regulatory Bureau of Energy Efficiency (BEE). Thus, a unit with more number stars shall consume lesser electricity in comparison with one with a lower star rating.

What To Buy? Split Or Window AC in 2018?

Now another important deciding factor is to understand what you really want. Whether you want a window air conditioner or a split model, although, window units are cheaper in comparison and they are easy to install, split air conditioners are quieter. Split air conditioners are aesthetically more pleasing and they provide a better air distribution.

The Money Matters:

Price is perhaps the most concerned factor. An air conditioner to contain more features and higher star ratings would account for a higher price tag on it. It is taken as estimation that for every increase in the star rating, there is an approximate increase of around Rs 2,500. Moreover, an Inverter air conditioner is usually priced at 20% higher as compared to a 5-Star rated Split air conditioner.

Quality Of Air:

The quality of indoor air is a very important factor while deploying ACs at home; thus an AC with a good filter is highly important to improve the indoor air quality. A good filter not only just ensures clean air, but it also enhances the cooling performance and the energy efficiency of the air conditioner by preventing the evaporator coil from choking due to dust.

Installation Requirements:

A window AC is made to be compact; it’s designed to be attached to the windows. While a split AC has one compressor unit outside of the house and an indoor unit which is fixed inside the room, this is specifically designed to achieve a better flow of air. It is should be made sure that the installation is done from an authorized service center. The parameter of a performance of the AC depends a lot on a good or bad installation.

Cleaning & Maintenance:

ACs are like cars, and just like cars, they need regular servicing for them to remain in the best of their condition and for an optimum performance. Once installed, there ought to be regular servicing, preferably every three months.

The Cooling Speed:

The air conditioner must have an adjustable thermostat (for temperature setting) and that should have at least two cooling speeds, that’s a minimum of two fan speeds, it’s that, you may want to have variable speeds for different times in a day. Moreover, a setting for energy efficiency would be a beneficial addition. This shall help in saving the consumption of energy and providing optimum cooling.

After Sales Services:

After sales services and check other add-on features such as warranty would there certainly be a plus for the purchase. Look for a brand that’s service oriented and has the capabilities and a good network to meet the servicing needs of your product.

Other Features:

Most air-conditioning units(ac units) come with a function of dehumidification. This reduces humidity in the air, for the purpose of increased cooling and more comfort. It is also important to check the levels of noise of the model, which may range from 19 to 60 decibels.  The sleep mode function in an air conditioner is useful in such a case as it automatically adjusts the required temperature during the night. The unit should also have a facility for an auto restart, this helps to restore the last setting that was made before any power break.

Usefulness:

Nowadays, the air conditioner is not just used only for cooling, but as a multi-seasonal product that can also be used during winters for heating. In addition to their usefulness, these Hot and Cold ACs also save up to 35 % more energy than heaters. Air conditioners are also considered as the best cooling devices for humid atmospheres. Special functions for cooling are required for the optimum cooling and maximum levels of comfort during monsoons. Hence, it is advised to look for an AC with features that can control humidity and give out more comfort in Monsoons as well.

Some Tips And Tricks:

Consider the below factors before deciding on Which Air Conditioner you should Buy in 2018.

Exposure to Sunlight & Heat:

If your room is closer to the kitchen or the wall of your room is directly exposed to the sun, you will need an air conditioner with higher cooling capacity.

Brand:

You should wisely choose an air conditioner brand, which fulfills your need of maximum energy saving through highest EER, extensive after-sales service and best cooling performance. The air conditioner you choose should have functions, which provide faster cooling in summers, best comfort in monsoon and protects from disease-causing infection, allergens and insects like Mosquitoes, etc.

Room Size:

The size/volume of the AC should be as per the size of your room. If it is bigger, it will not be able to provide suitable dehumidification and the smaller one will cost you more in terms of energy consumption. Room ACs are obtainable in the capacity range of 0.75 to 2-ton. Inverter AC with adjustable tonnage can be used for a wider range of room sizes/volumes.

Weather Conditions:

While choosing one should look for air conditioners that can work capably even in the extreme weather conditions of Indian summers.

Usage:

If your AC usage is 8 to 10Hrs a day for 3 to 4 months, it is suggested to buy at least 3-Star rated AC. In case, AC usage is extended for 5 to 7 months, you should opt for 5-Star rated AC. For usage of 10 to 12 months, one should opt for cooling only or cold & hot Inverter AC. Make a smart investment this summer by selecting an air conditioner that meets your above requirements and offers you a pleasure of ownership.

Advantages And Disadvantages Of Air Conditioners:

Air conditioners are the finest way of beating the scorching summer heat. They can be helpful in making the hot summer days manageable and improve the indoor air quality. By altering the temperature of the air conditioner according to your needs, you can feel contented in all seasons. However, air conditioners can also raise the risk of certain health problems, mainly when you fail to maintain and clean them properly. This article explains the major advantages and disadvantages of using air conditioners.

Advantages of an Air Conditioner:

Below are the Advantages of Air Conditioner for your Health and lifestyle.

Prevents Heat And Dehydration Strokes

Being exposed to excessive heat for long times can cause dehydration. This is because high temperature leads to generous sweating and makes your body lose water. If you fail to replenish this lost water, the consequence will be dehydrated. Since air conditioners reduce sweating, they can minimize the risk of water loss and dehydration. Heat strokes are the other problem that excessive heat can cause. This is because too much heat makes it difficult for the body to adjust its temperature. Failing to treat this problem quickly enough can cause damage to the brain &other organs of the body. Since air conditioners reduce the temperature of the air, they can be obliging in preventing heat strokes.

Improves The Air Quality

Air conditioners can significantly improve indoor air quality & create a much healthier atmosphere. As they are capable of filtering out dust, pollen& other allergens present in the environment. By reducing humidity, air conditioners can check the growth of mildew and mold.

Reduce Asthma And Allergies

Air conditions can help to filter as well as disinfect the air that we respire. This can help to reduce the risk of asthma attacks and allergies by removing pollen and dust, and preventing the growth of mildew & mold. Being exposed to mold is one of the main aspects that increase the risk of asthma attacks, allergic reactions, and other respiratory issues. The fact that we close our windows while using air conditioners helps to avoid the entry of environmental allergens, bacteria, and dust.

Disadvantages Of An Air Conditioner:

Below are the disadvantages of an Air Conditioner for your Health and Lifestyle.

Skin Dryness

Spending the bigger amount of time in an air-conditioned room can make your skin lose its moisture, thereby becoming sensitive and dry. It can also cause irritation & dryness of mucous membranes.

Aggravation Of Respiratory Problems

A quick change in temperature has shown to exacerbate the symptoms of various respiratory diseases. Fortunately, you can significantly lessen the risk of this problem by setting a higher temperature& decreasing it gradually.

Respiratory Tract Infections And Allergies

Not cleaning the air conditioner can cause the accumulation of dust, bacteria, and pollen in the air filters. This will significantly raise the risk of asthma attacks and respiratory tract infections. Being exposed to the cool air-conditioned air for too long can lead to a sore throat, runny nose, sinus problems, & other similar symptoms. Some air conditioners do not have the ability to humidify the air, thereby making the air very dry. Dry air can end in irritation of the lining of the mouth and the nose. The best way of decreasing the risks associated with the use of air conditioners is to have them cleaned on a regular basis. A clean &well-maintained air conditioner will have more health advantages and few disadvantages.

The Air And Your Health

Everybody is subject to basic environmental conditions, which need management. Even people in excellent health can suffer from temperatures & the invisible airborne particles which are existing in every building and human environment. Fumes, insecticides, stale air, and other problems are to be managed. Even the basic odors are the symptoms of needing better air quality. A smell directs chemically active particles in the air. These issues are not necessarily toxic, but they do not do much for your breathing. A new air conditioner can solve all of these problems.

Temperatures And Comfort

Fatigue can be caused by excessive cold or heat. You can get minor, but repetitive conditions like headaches, colds, coughing, discomfort, and other elusive symptoms. Temperatures and humidity affect how the body works. Too much cold or heat can use up energy, quite rapidly in some cases. You may feel tired, and not be sure why. You can get dehydration from a low humid environment, or from an environment, which is too humid, which, in return makes you lose water as your body tries to adjust to the environment.

Long-Term Benefits Of Air Conditioning

Continuous, repetitive stress on your body does not make your immune system much good, either. Over long periods, the result is wearing down your resistance to these nuisance conditions, making you more vulnerable to the infections. On the other hand, long-term air conditioning, also reduces stresses over a period, allowing full recovery, & ending the repetitive cycle of conditions. Simply installing a dependable air conditioning system can make all the difference. You will notice the improvement instantly!

Required Tonnage of Air Conditioner = Height X Floor size/Length of your room X Width.

title.rendered: The Cost of AC Repair: What to Expect and How to Avoid Overpaying

content.rendered:
India is known for its scorching heat, which makes air conditioners (ACs) an integral part of every household and workplace. However, like most appliances, ACs are subject to occasional breakdowns which require repairs. The ability to anticipate the costs for repair ac units in India is important in order not to overspend.

The Cost of AC Repair: What to Expect and How to Avoid Overpaying

In this article, we’ll look at common repair costs in India, breakdown the various factors leading to different prices, and articulate how you can make sure you are not being charged excess.

 1 Ways to Check What Kind of AC Repair is Needed and Its Cost!

To determine the costs, the first thing you ought to do is comprehend all the possible types of repair that may be needed. The cost can differ based on the specific problems, the kind of AC unit, and the level of skill required to repair it. Here are the A.C. issues that are most common and usually result in repairs being needed:

 a) Issues with Compressors

Compressor problems usually stem from other issues with the A.C. unit; if these problems escalate, cooling will almost completely cease. In most cases, problems have arisen in the heat exchanger, evaporator, and expansion valve. Due to the cost of repairs, the most common solution is to replace the unit and its various components instead of trying to service them.

 b) Leakage of the Refrigerant

Another issue that is not too uncommon: Refrigerant coolant leakage can occur from several points on the AC unit like the tubes, heating vessels etc. Besides growing in severity, these problems can and will affect the units cooling proficiency. EC are low on coolant, this can be the reason. The leak must be located and repaired for the air conditioner to regain its ability to generate cooled air.

 c) Fan Issues

Broken fans offer another concern, especially in window air conditioners. Damaged fans are replaced for an additional fee. Windows A.C. units intakes warm air, cools it utilizing built in condenser coils within the device, and then fuels the cooled air back into the room. If the fan is broken, the A.C. will not operate properly. Compared to problems with the compressor, fan fixes are more economical, but also expensive enough to necessitate calling a technician.

 d) Repairs to Control Unit Errors

A malfunctioning control unit can explain the variance in room temperature. Let’s consider, what could happen if a faulty thermostat cannot control the temperature settings? The air conditioner could blow excessively warm air or cold air at random times, or could turn off when it is not supposed to. Generally, replacing or repairing control units is one of the simpler tasks to undertake.

 e) Ducts or airflow problems

Air conditioner efficiency is los at its best if duct systems range from blockages to leaks. Indeed ducts can be cleaned and repaired, but depending upon the severity of damage, the price held can vary greatly.

 f) Ac Power Problems

Like everything else related to the ac system, blown fuses, faulty wiring, and tripped circuit breakers can also make your air unit inoperable. Some costs are broken down to make understanding the simplicity or complexity of electrical repairs easier. Understanding the severity of the solution needed defines the cost from around 500 to more than 2500 rupees.

 2. Average Costs of AC Repairs in India

In India, precise AC repair expenses are influenced by certain factors such as location, specific type of services needed, and AC brand. Below is a breakdown of the average costs of AC repairs:

 a) Window AC Repair Cost

As regards to window AC units, repairs on these devices typically range from ₹500 to ₹4,000 based on the particular problem. Fixing the thermostat or filter cleaning generally goes for a fee of about ₹500 to ₹1,000. Conversely, replacing the compressor together with the unit’s other mechanical parts can cost in the region of ₹4,000+.

 b) Split AC Repair Cost

Split ACs are a little more expensive in terms of system repairs because they are more complex. In Split AC Repairs, the average works with around ₹1,000 to ₹8,000. More extensive or detailed works, such as the changing of the compressor or the repair of leak refrigerant fixes can cost towards ₹12,000–₹15,000.

 c) Cost of Repairing an Inverter AC

Inverter ACs are more expensive because they utilize sophisticated technology and are fuel-efficient. The average cost of repairing an Inverter AC is between ₹1,500 and ₹12,000 but can vary based on the type of problem. The price, however, can become significantly greater than ₹15,000 if the issue is with the inverter compressor.

 d) Cost of Refrigerant Recharge

Refrigerant recharge is an essential service for air conditioning units and is charged regularly on account of refrigerant leakages. The cost will generally range between ₹1,000 and ₹3,000 but depending on the AC brand, it can be more. In particular, more expensive brands and Inverter models are likely to charge more.

 3. Things Considered When Costing Repairs for an AC in India

Estimating the expense of repairing an AC is tricky, and many factors need to be told to the customer, such as the brand or type of air conditioner he has. These factors can also explain why the pricing is so high for air conditioners. Even more so, premium brands have higher fees when it comes to servicing the AC due to the price of spare parts and skilled engineers. Having Inverter ACs is especially beneficial since they always increase the servicing fees and parts prices.

Note that parts and skills needed to repair ACs also differ based on the HVAC service contractors.

 b) Repair Mechanical Work

Just like most things, the cost of repair will vary based on the type and scope of work that is required. Simple maintenance such as replacing a fuse or even cleaning the filters will usually costs less than a complete component replacement which includes the compressor or even the evaporator coil.

 c) Usual Charge for Repair Service In Different Areas

The wide variance of repair costs can also be attributed to geographic region. In larger metropolitan towns such as Delhi, Mumbai or Bengaluru, repair services tend to cost a lot more than in smaller towns or cities. This tends to happen because of the higher rates of wages and increase in cost for servicemen and fuel.

 d) Service Charge for Repairing AC Unit by Expert Technician in Hours

When hiring the services of a technician to perform AC Unit repairs, service charges often vary between ₹300 to ₹1,000 per hour. The factors affecting this service charge depend on the type of repair needed as well as the area of expertise of the technician. There are also set minimum charges for service calls that range from ₹200 to ₹500 regardless of whether any work is done or not.

 e. Cost of Spare Parts: EAC Spare Parts Supply and Service Costs}

Just like in other brands, the cost of spare parts is different for all brands and makes of ACs. More expensive brands are likely to have parts that are differentiated by brand and are more costly than average ones. For high end brands, for example, a compressor replacement can cost well above ₹10,000, but goes for ₹6,000 at lower end brands.

 4. Ways to Not Exceed your Set Budget on AC Repair Cost

Repairs on ACs can be expensive, but knowing a few tips can help you avoid getting ripped off. To help you rest easy, below are some tips that make it clear why you are paying the best service cost without getting ripped off.

 a. Compare Prices

Before signing a contract with any service provider, try getting a quote from at least two or three. This is good practice because it allows you to inspect the outcomes and steer clear of being ripped off.

 b. Get Them from Authorized Services Only

Having authorized service centers or reputable repair firms means that you are paying for adequate service and dependable equipment. Unlike independent technicians that charge cheaper rates, they do know how to install spare parts and are experienced.

 c) Ask for Transparent Pricing

Instead of confronting a repair with payment, ask the repairman to itemize each category that has a cost attached. This should account for labor, spare parts, and service fees. An honest technician should give you a breakdown of the costs.

 d) Check the Warranty on Repairs

If your AC is operating under a warranty, make sure the repair work you intend to carry out on it is also warranted. A lot of companies do give warranties on parts and labor, and utilizing it smartly can save you a lot of dollars. Always ask about warranty terms before the repairs are done.

 e) Regular Maintenance

Proper maintenance, such as cleaning filters and checking refrigerant levels periodically can deal with a lot of common issues and keep the repairs economical. Getting your AC serviced once a year can also help catch any problems early on so that dealing with them will be less expensive in the future.

 f) Don’t Overpay for Minor Issues

This is where the lack of knowledge can cost you big. If there is an AC not cooling well, it might just need a little servicing such as unclogging a filter. Always ask about less expensive options first if you suspect the issue is not as severe as it seems.

 5. Conclusion

As noted, the pricing for AC repair in India is not always the same, but with adequate research, you can avoid overspending on services. Knowing common problems with AC systems, the factors that affect pricing, and how to avoid common mistakes can help make sure that your AC unit is adequately serviced without spending too much money.

Always, keep in mind to consult multiple service providers, use only reputable service companies, and schedule regular servicing to head off expensive repairs later to ensure that you do not suffer expensive breakdowns in the future. Remember, your investment in research and planning will ensure that you are able to keep your AC functional over the year and save a good amount of money in the process.

Top Tips to Avoid Overpaying for AC Repairs in India

  1. Get Multiple Quotes
    Always compare prices from at least two or three repair service providers. This ensures you’re getting a fair price and can help you avoid overpaying.
  2. Choose Authorized Service Centers
    Opt for authorized service providers or reputable companies. They typically offer better quality parts, more reliable technicians, and warranties on their work, which can save you money in the long run.
  3. Request Transparent Pricing
    Ask your technician for a clear breakdown of the cost before the work begins. This should include labor, parts, and any other service charges. Transparent pricing helps you avoid hidden fees.
  4. Check for Warranties
    If your AC is under warranty, make sure the repairs are covered. Many brands offer warranties on parts and labor, so utilizing it could save you a significant amount on repair costs.
  5. Prioritize Regular Maintenance
    Regularly clean the filters, check refrigerant levels, and schedule annual servicing to prevent minor issues from turning into costly repairs. Routine maintenance can also help catch problems early, reducing future expenses.
  6. Don’t Overpay for Simple Fixes
    If your AC is underperforming, check for simple fixes first—like cleaning filters or ensuring the settings are correct. Don’t rush into costly repairs without considering cheaper solutions.
  7. Stay Informed About Common Issues
    Familiarize yourself with common AC problems (like compressor issues, refrigerant leaks, and fan malfunctions). Understanding these will help you identify when you’re being charged for unnecessary repairs.

3. Factors Affecting Refrigerator Repair Charges in Vadodara

Understanding what affects refrigerator repair charges can help you anticipate costs and manage your budget. Several factors determine the total cost of a refrigerator repair service in Vadodara, including the type of refrigerator, the issue at hand, and labor costs. Here’s a deeper look:

Type of Refrigerator

Refrigerator models range from basic single-door fridges to high-tech side-by-side or French door models. More advanced refrigerators tend to have complex systems, requiring more time and expertise to repair. For instance:

  • Single-door refrigerators: Generally easier and cheaper to repair.
  • Double-door refrigerators: May involve slightly higher repair costs due to more advanced technology.
  • Side-by-side and French door refrigerators: These models are complex and can incur higher repair charges.

Extent of Damage or Issue

A minor issue like a broken door seal or faulty thermostat will be significantly cheaper to repair than a major problem like a compressor failure or motor malfunction. Here are some common issues and how they affect the repair costs:

  • Broken thermostat:
  • Faulty compressor:

Availability of Spare Parts

The cost of refrigerator repair also depends on the availability and cost of spare parts. Labor Charges in Vadodara

The Anatomy of an AC Failure

Why your AC is taking longer to cool the room, and how we fix it.

The “Biofilm” Threat

When warm room air hits the freezing evaporator coil, condensation occurs. This constant moisture traps microscopic dust, creating a sticky, insulating layer known as Biofilm.

Because this biofilm acts as an insulator, the refrigerant inside the copper pipes cannot absorb the heat from your room. The compressor has to work twice as hard, doubling your electricity bill and eventually leading to thermal overload (compressor failure).

title.rendered: Home Air Conditioner Maintenance Tips

content.rendered:
Making sure your air conditioner is running effectively isn’t just a matter of comfort, and it’s an issue of safety and health. Air conditioning repair tips or air conditioner maintenance tips are helpful in controlling humidity. The control of humidity can help keep out the growth of mold and mildew. Inhibiting the growth of mildew and mold helps protect your respiratory health.

Then, here Atlas Aircon – Best AC Service Centre in Vadodara shares 5 AC maintenance tips to ensure that your unit is functioning efficiently:

5 Best Tips for Air Conditioner Maintenance

1. Change Your Air Filters

Your HVAC system is equipped with air filters designed to trap pets’ dirt, hair, and other pollutants. The filters stop these contaminants from interfering with the system’s operation.

As time passes, the filters can become dirty or get clogged up. Dirty filters can result in the formation of icing on the air conditioning unit, making the unit further than it should. Changing your filters every month is a good way to avoid this issue.

2. Clear Away Plants and Bushes

The air conditioner needs a free flow of air to work effectively. As flower beds, bushes, grass, weeds, or grass develop around the unit, they block the airflow, pushing the unit more than is needed.

Get rid of all plant life that you can find in the vicinity of the unit. It will ensure that the unit receives sufficient air, and Air Conditioner Maintenance Tips it will ensure a better appliance to be used in your house.

3. Check the Drain Line

Your air conditioner must eliminate excess moisture from the condenser, and this drain line may become blocked with algae.

It is recommended to perform preventative maintenance by cleaning the line periodically using a tiny amount of bleach, and one cup is usually enough to be enough.

If mold or algae has blocked the drain most of the time, a simple dry or wet vacuum cleaner will typically remove the obstruction.

4. Get a Programmable Thermostat

Many people keep their air conditioners on all day long, cooling their empty home or apartment. Many people do not remember to set the thermostat before heading out of the door, which can reduce the life of the unit and cost you money.

A programmable thermostat eliminates the human aspect. The thermostat is programmed to set the temperature you desire at various times during the day. You will save money and prolong the useful life of the appliance home ac maintenance tips.

5. Schedule Professional Maintenance

You don’t always notice many things that could cause problems with an air conditioner. A certified technician can test these issues, which include:

  • Electrical components
  • Mechanical components
  • Coolant levels
  • The integrity of the duct

A call to a professional at least once or twice per year will ensure that your AC remains in good working order throughout the time it is.

Parting Thoughts on Tips for Air Conditioner Maintenance

Maintenance of your AC plays an important part in enhancing the performance of your AC unit. A good DIY maintenance program can ensure proper drainage and airflow. A thermostat with programmable functions ensures that you don’t use the unit over the recommended amount of time. Professional maintenance ensures that mechanical and electrical components continue to function properly.

A split AC unit is an air conditioning system that has two separate units – one located inside the building and the other located outside. The indoor unit contains the evaporator coil and blower, while the outdoor unit contains the compressor and condenser.

Air Conditioner Installation

Air conditioners Installation are one of the most important things that everyone needs in their house these days. They make human life very comfortable. There are many things that you need to take care of when you are buying an air conditioner. When you are spending so much for an air conditioner, then you will have to take a lot of care for it. An air conditioner is not something that you can buy every year or replace it every year. Air Conditioner Installation and maintenance of it has to be handled with a lot of care. Before you go ahead with the AC Installation Service and process, choosing the right model of an air conditioner is very important.

Selecting The Right Air Conditioner For Your House

There are so many things that you need to consider before you go ahead and start your air conditioner shopping. Here are a few things that you need to check before you buy one:

1) Features

Search and Make sure that the Air Conditioner you are looking for has all the features you need.

Don’t go with the basic features of the heating process and the cooling process.

But you also have many other features like the temperature adjustment, timer setting, automatic temperature adjustment and many more.

The price of the air conditioner will definitely depend on the features of the air conditioner.

Most advanced and interesting features the air conditioner has, then high is the price.

2) Size Of The Air Conditioner

The size of the air conditioner is a very important factor that you need to consider before you buy the air conditioner.

If you are buying the wrong size, then you will end up with a big problem.

Don’t choose a smaller size or a bigger one.

You should always measure the right size and then buy it accordingly. Size does not just mean the fitting of the air conditioner.

Fitting is important in case of a window air conditioner only.

The size parameter is important for another thing as well and that is the size of the room.

The air conditioner that you are buying should be able to cool the room that you are installing it in.

When the room size is big, then the number of tons of air conditioner should be high.

Else you will not be able to maintain the temperature of the room as per your choice.

4) Energy Efficiency

The air conditioner that you are choosing should be energy efficient.

Means, it should be given maximum output and at the same time, it should be given the minimum bill.

Many models are available on the market today which will be able to save you a lot of money and at the same time, they are really effective as well.

They may be a little expensive, but you are going to spend just one time, rather than paying high bills every time.

5) Check The Warranty Period

It can be really hard to find that all the air conditioners that are available today are having a good warranty period.

But the minimum warranty that you can expect is one year and sometime you will also be able to get more.

The warranty should be included in all the parts of the air conditioner and hence you need to be very careful and check the details well.

6) Noise Factor

Another important factor that you need to check is the noise factor of the air conditioner.

You will have the window air conditioners usually making noise and the split air conditioners would be making a little noise in rare conditions.

But now you have air conditioners which do not make any noise these days.

So, you can go for that kind of air conditioners.

7) Durability Of The Air Conditioner

The durability of the air conditioner has to be checked before you buy them.

One of the ways you can be sure about the durability of the air conditioner is by choosing the right brand.

Yes, you should always make sure that you are choosing top brands.

Check the reviews and feedbacks about the air conditioners before you buy them.

8) Price Of The Air Conditioner

Last but not the least factor of the air conditioner is the price.

Make sure that you are checking enough brands and models before you decide on which one to buy.

You will be able to get an air conditioner at a better price with the same feature from another brand.

That does not mean that you will have to go for the one which is cheaper.

You will have to check if the other brand is reliable.

There is no point in saving a few bucks when you cannot guarantee that this savings is going to help you for a long time.

All the above factors are must when you are buying an air conditioner whether it is split air conditioner, window air conditioner, stand-alone air conditioner or a central air conditioner.

You will be able to get a good home air conditioner, in fact, the one that is worth every penny that you are spending on the air conditioner. So, choose wisely and be careful.

Installation Process Of A Window Air Conditioner:

It is not going to be tough at all to install a window air conditioner in your house. You will not need more than an hour for its installation. If you are having professionals for handling the task, then it will be done much faster. The attachment models of each air conditioner would be different and you should be careful about the installation process. Usually, you will have the installation manual along with the air conditioner and you can refer that to get some help regarding the installation process. You will have to measure the window size and unit size. If the window size is large or the unit is not installed in the right way, then the unit is going to fall down. You need to be careful with the measurements.

Here are the steps involved in the installation of a window air conditioner:

1) Open The Bottom Sash You will have to make sure that you have completely opened the bottom sash of the window. If the window is having any screen, then that screen also has to be removed. Once the sash is opened and the window screen is removed, you will have to clean the area with a vacuum. Cleaning is very important for the maintenance of the window air conditioner. 2) Extension Preparation Has To Be Done When you are buying an air conditioner, then you will notice that most of the window air conditioners will come with sliding. This sliding will completely open up so that the window is filled up. A few models of the air conditioner which have they attached and for a few other models, you will have to slide them to the conditioner channel. Make sure that the air conditioner is prepared with all this stuff before it is actually placed in the air conditioner fitting area. 3) Mounting Brackets To Be Prepared You will be able to find two kinds of window air conditioners in the market. One of the air conditioners is the unit will be placed on the sill of the window. But there are other types of a window air conditioner as well and that will have the mounting brackets for placing the air conditioner. You will have to make sure that you are installing the brackets in the right way. The entire process is present in the instructions manual given by the manufacturer. 4) Place The Air Conditioner Unit Properly Now comes the most important step of air conditioner installation and that is placing your air conditioner in its place. You will need the help of another person for placing the window air conditioning unit in its place. You will have to do this placing process from inside and not outside. Also, You will have to lift it with a lot of care and make sure that the unit is sitting exactly on the sill of the window. If the unit is having mounting brackets, then you will have to place the unit in the brackets that are prepared already. Make sure that the brackets get locked after you are placing the air conditioning unit in place. Hold the air conditioner for some time and check it well with the help of your helper. Be sure about the placement of the air conditioner before you leave it. If there is any draining tube to the air conditioning unit, then you should make sure at this point in time only that you are placing it outside. 5) Place The Window Sash Properly You should now lower the upper sash of the window so that it sits flat on the top of the unit, be very careful while you are doing this. Make sure that the upper sash is parallel with the lower sash of the window. Make sure that there are no gaps in the air conditioning unit. 6) Inner Perimeter Should Be Sealed In order to avoid any kind of air to pass in and out of the room, you will have to make sure that you are sealing the inner perimeter with a lot of care. Use the foam for sealing it and then that is going to help in retaining the right temperature inside the room in which an air conditioner is installed. 7) Plug In The Window Air Conditioner You are now done with the installation of the air conditioning unit and it is time to plug and enjoy the cool temperature in your house. Now, check the unit and make sure that everything on the unit is working well and you are able to enjoy a cool temperature in the room. So, the installation is not going to take much time of yours, but you will need the professionals for doing this task. It is the professionals who will be able to do it in the right way and hence you will also be able to enjoy the comfort of an air conditioner. Sometimes, when you are installing a window air conditioner, then you will not be able to use the window at all. If you think that it is sealing you from using the window, then you can install the air conditioner when not in use. That means, in the winter and rainy season you can remove the air and store it in the right way. Now you will be able to use the window as well.

Installation Process Of A Split Air Conditioner

As you are now done with the installation process of the window air conditioner. It is now time to have a look at the installation process of a split air conditioner. The process of installing a split air conditioner is also very simple, just like the window air conditioner. In fact, you will be able to install the split air conditioner much faster than the window unit.

Here is the stepwise procedure for the installation of the split air conditioner:

1) Wall Bracket Installation

In order to mount the split air conditioner to the wall, you will need the bracket that is provided by the manufacturer.

You will have to make holes in the wall according to the requirement.

The bracket is usually of aluminium. The indoor unit will be fixed to this bracket.

Mark the whole points with a lot of care and then you will have to drill with a lot more care.

You will have to fix the bracket on the wall with the help of the screws provided by the manufacturer.

2) Make One Large Hole In The Wall

After you have made the required holes for fixing the bracket on the wall, now it is time to make a large hole on the same wall.

Make the hole large enough to pass the copper pipes through it, which is usually called as the refrigerant tube.

Along with that, you will also have to pass the electric cable which will be connecting the outdoor unit to the indoor unit and the drain hose as well.

3) Install The Indoor Unit Inside

You should now start the installation of the indoor unit in the room in which you want to get the air conditioner fixed.

Place the indoor unit very carefully on the bracket that is provided for the indoor unit installation.

Parallelly pass the electric cable and the water drain hose through the hole which is already made.

You will have to leave the drainage hose free for the water to drain out when the air conditioner is running.

4) Install The Outdoor Unit Outside

The next step of the split air conditioner installation is installing the outdoor unit.

The outdoor unit is usually heavy and hence you should make sure that you are lifting it with a lot of care.

It would be good if you are taking the help of another person for lifting the outdoor unit.

You can install the outdoor unit outside the room in which the indoor unit installed.

It will be easy for connecting the electric wire between them.

Place it on a wall outside the room and make sure that the wall on which you are placing the indoor unit is strong enough that it can hold the weight of the outdoor unit.

5) Install The Copper Pipes

The next step is to connect the copper pipes between the indoor unit and the outdoor unit.

6) Install The Electric Connections

The next and the final step would be to connect the indoor unit and the outdoor unit with the electrical connections.

7) Check The Air Conditioner

The final check has to be done once the air conditioner is installed.

Once the indoor unit and the outdoor units are fitted, then you will have to make sure that the electrical connection is also given.

You can now switch it on and check if the air conditioner is working or not.

Switch it off once and then again switch it on and then check it to make sure that it is working properly.

With this, you are done with the installation of the split air conditioner as well. You will be able to enjoy the room at the temperature of your choice.

Find The Right Professional For Installation
